posts.text: R to @vxunderground: The reason many of you are seeing me discuss malware reverse engineering lately is because I've temporarily shifted my focus to malware defense, rather offense. A majority of my life, and goop with malware, has been malware development. I love writing malware. However, the past couple of months-ish I felt kind of bored with malware development. I was just kind of burned out. From the recommendations of the people living inside my computer, I decided to shift to malware defense. If anyone remembers, I spent awhile studying the internals of YARA and built my own YARA scanner thingie. Anyway, it's been a lot of fun bonking malware with a stick. It's given me better perspective on what does, and what does not, work offensively. Thank you everyone for giving me malware you find in the wild. It is better to bonk random malware, versus malware already bonked, because there is no "cheat sheet" of someone else's research or notes. I'm going in completely blind and it's fun.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @vxunderground：你們中的許多人最近看到我討論惡意軟體逆向工程的原因是因為我暫時將注意力轉移到惡意軟體防禦上，而不是攻擊上。我一生的大部分時間以及與惡意軟體相關的大部分時間都是在惡意軟體開發中。我喜歡編寫惡意軟體。然而，在過去的幾個月裡，我對惡意軟體的開發感到有點厭倦。我只是有點精疲力盡了。根據我電腦內人員的建議，我決定轉向​​惡意軟體防禦。如果有人還記得的話，我花了一段時間研究 YARA 的內部結構並建立了我自己的 YARA 掃描器。不管怎樣，用棍子攻擊惡意軟體是一件很有趣的事。它讓我更了解什麼能起到進攻作用，什麼不能起到進攻作用。感謝大家向我提供在野外發現的惡意軟體。攻擊隨機惡意軟體比攻擊已經攻擊的惡意軟體更好，因為沒有其他人的研究或筆記的「備忘錄」。我會完全盲目地進去，這很有趣。

posts.text: 🇲🇽 Mexican Government Employee Data Allegedly Leaked A threat actor claims to have leaked employee data associated with SEP Tlaxcala, Mexico's state education authority. * The listing alleges the exposure of employee records spanning 2012–2026. * Claimed data includes medical information, passwords, email addresses, RFC tax IDs, full names, and additional personnel records. * The seller states the data is in JSON format and originates from an internal employee document management portal. * Sample records were published, but the authenticity of the data and the alleged compromise have not been independently verified. Analyst Note: If confirmed, the exposure of government employee records containing medical information and authentication data could present significant privacy, identity theft, and credential compromise risks. Organizations should treat the claim seriously while awaiting official confirmation. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Mexico

posts.text: 🇦🇷 Argentina's National Seed Institute (INASE) Allegedly Breached A threat actor using the name "Ownzs3c" claims to have breached the online portal of Argentina's National Seed Institute (INASE), the government agency responsible for regulating the country's agricultural seed sector. * The actor claims data belonging to 3,043 individuals was obtained from the organization's online portal. * A sample screenshot was published, allegedly showing names, locations, phone numbers, and email addresses. * The threat actor included a message directed at the Argentine government and shared a link to the purported leaked data. * At the time of writing, there is no independent confirmation that the alleged breach or exposed dataset is authentic. Analyst Note: If verified, the incident could expose employees, researchers, agricultural organizations, and other stakeholders to targeted phishing and social engineering attacks. The scope and authenticity of the claimed breach remain unconfirmed. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Argentina

posts.text: 🚨 Handala Claims Attack on Wisconsin ISP, Alleges Widespread Internet Disruption The pro-Palestinian hacktivist group Handala claims it has compromised the core infrastructure of SupraNet Communications, an internet service provider based in Madison, Wisconsin. * The group alleges the attack caused widespread internet outages affecting businesses, government networks, and critical city services. * Handala published screenshots that appear to show access to ISP network management interfaces as proof of the claimed intrusion. * The statement frames the incident as retaliation and warns of additional cyber operations. At the time of writing, there is no independent evidence confirming that Handala successfully compromised SupraNet or that the reported outages were caused by a cyberattack. The claims should be treated as unverified until corroborated by the ISP or independent technical analysis. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Wisconsin
posts.text_zh: 🚨 Handala 聲稱威斯康辛州 ISP 受到攻擊，聲稱大範圍的互聯網中斷親巴勒斯坦的黑客組織 Handala 聲稱它已經破壞了位於威斯康星州麥迪遜市的互聯網服務提供商 SupraNet Communications 的核心基礎設施。 * 該組織聲稱此攻擊導致大規模的網路中斷，影響企業、政府網路和重要的城市服務。 * Handala 發布了似乎顯示對 ISP 網路管理介面的存取的螢幕截圖，作為所聲稱的入侵的證據。 * 聲明將該事件描述為報復行為，並警告進行更多網路行動。截至撰寫本文時，沒有獨立證據證實 Handala 成功入侵 SupraNet 或報告的中斷是由網路攻擊引起的。在 ISP 或獨立技術分析證實之前，這些聲明應被視為未經驗證。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Wisconsin

posts.text: 🚨 Fanjoy Customer Order Database Allegedly Leaked A threat actor has posted what they claim is the full customer order database of Fanjoy, an influencer merchandise and e-commerce platform. * The listing claims to contain 487,456 order records in CSV format. * Allegedly exposed data includes customer email addresses, shipping and billing addresses, order details, payment metadata, IP addresses, timestamps, and platform identifiers. * The dataset is dated March 2025 according to the forum post. * Sample records were shared to support the claim, but the authenticity of the data has not been independently verified. Analyst Note: If authentic, the exposed information could enable phishing campaigns, account takeover attempts, and targeted fraud against customers. Organizations handling e-commerce data should verify the claim, assess potential exposure, and notify affected users if confirmed. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Fanjoy

posts.text: 🇿🇦 S. Africa — MTN Data Breach Allegedly Claimed A threat actor claims to have breached MTN, one of Africa's largest telecommunications providers, alleging the theft of customer and employee credentials. * The forum post claims customer email addresses and passwords were obtained. * The actor also alleges approximately 2,000 employee credentials were compromised. * The post does not specify which MTN operating company or country is affected. * A download link is advertised on the underground forum, but no verifiable technical evidence or dataset details were provided. Analyst Note: These claims remain unverified. Given MTN's presence across multiple African markets, the affected business unit and the authenticity of the alleged data should be confirmed before assessing the full impact. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Africa
posts.text_zh: 🇿🇦 南非 — 據稱 MTN 資料外洩 一名威脅行為者聲稱已入侵非洲最大的電信供應商之一 MTN，並指控客戶和員工憑證被盜。 * 論壇貼文聲稱已取得客戶電子郵件地址和密碼。 * 該演員還聲稱大約 2,000 名員工憑證洩露。 * 該貼文並未具體說明哪個 MTN 營運公司或國家受到影響。 * 地下論壇上公佈了下載鏈接，但未提供可驗證的技術證據或資料集詳細資訊。分析師註：這些說法尚未得到證實。鑑於 MTN 遍佈多個非洲市場，在評估全面影響之前，應先確認受影響的業務部門和所指控數據的真實性。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Africa

posts.text: 🇪🇸 Spain — Nfinite9000 Data Allegedly Leaked A threat actor claims to have leaked data belonging to Nfinite9000, a Spanish IT services and cloud solutions provider. * The forum post targets Nfinite9000, a company providing managed IT services, cloud infrastructure, backup solutions, email security, and technical support. * The actor claims to have leaked the company's data and shared what is described as proof of the compromise. * No record count or detailed description of the exposed data was provided in the post. * The authenticity and scope of the alleged breach have not been independently verified. Analyst Note: If confirmed, a compromise of a managed IT service provider could have broader downstream implications, potentially exposing customer information, infrastructure details, or credentials that may be leveraged in follow-on attacks. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Spain
posts.text_zh: 🇪🇸 西班牙 — Nfinite9000 資料據稱外洩 威脅行為者聲稱洩漏了屬於西班牙 IT 服務和雲端解決方案供應商 Nfinite9000 的資料。 * 該論壇貼文針對 Nfinite9000，這是一家提供託管 IT 服務、雲端基礎設施、備份解決方案、電子郵件安全和技術支援的公司。 * 該行為者聲稱洩露了公司的數據並分享了所謂的妥協證據。 * 貼文中沒有提供暴露資料的記錄計數或詳細描述。 * 所指控的違規行為的真實性和範圍尚未經過獨立核實。分析師註釋：如果得到證實，託管 IT 服務提供者的妥協可能會產生更廣泛的下游影響，可能會暴露客戶資訊、基礎設施詳細資訊或可能在後續攻擊中利用的憑證。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Spain

posts.text: 🇽🇰 Kosovo — Historic Albanian Citizenship Database Resurfaces on Underground Forum A threat actor has published what is claimed to be a historical Albanian citizenship database originating from Kosovo, making the dataset freely available for download. * The post claims the dataset dates back to 2008. * The actor alleges the database contains approximately 7.18 million records. * Claimed data fields include full names, dates of birth, sex, civil status, location, family member information, nationality, and other personal details. * The advertised archive is approximately 275 MB compressed and 1.3 GB uncompressed. Analyst Note: This appears to be the resurfacing of a historical dataset rather than evidence of a new intrusion. The authenticity, completeness, and origin of the data have not been independently verified. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Kosovo
posts.text_zh: 🇽🇰 科索沃 — 阿爾巴尼亞歷史公民身份資料庫在地下論壇上重新出現 威脅行為者發布了據稱源自科索沃的阿爾巴尼亞歷史公民身份資料庫，該資料集可供免費下載。 * 該貼文聲稱該資料集可以追溯到 2008 年。 * 該行為者聲稱該資料庫包含約 718 萬筆記錄。 * 聲稱的資料欄位包括全名、出生日期、性別、公民身份、位置、家庭成員資訊、國籍和其他個人詳細資料。 * 公佈的存檔壓縮後大小約為 275 MB，未壓縮時大小約 1.3 GB。分析師註：這似乎是歷史資料集的重新出現，而不是新入侵的證據。資料的真實性、完整性和來源尚未獨立驗證。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Kosovo

posts.text: ShinyHunters breach data repurposed for a $2,000 sextortion campaign Cybercriminals are using email addresses from datasets previously published by ShinyHunters to send targeted-looking sextortion messages demanding $2,000 in Bitcoin. Confirmed source datasets include information attributed to breaches involving Amtrak, Hallmark, Substack, Betterment, CarGurus, ADT, Panera Bread, and McGraw Hill. BleepingComputer verified that some recipients’ addresses appeared in the referenced leaked datasets. The scammers falsely claim they compromised recipients’ devices, cameras, and browsing activity. There is no evidence supporting those device-compromise claims, and ShinyHunters denied operating the campaign. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #ShinyHunters
posts.text_zh: ShinyHunters 洩漏的資料已重新用於 2,000 美元的性勒索活動網路犯罪分子正在使用 ShinyHunters 之前發布的資料集中的電子郵件地址發送看起來有針對性的性勒索訊息，要求提供 2,000 美元的比特幣。已確認的來源資料集包括涉及 Amtrak、Hallmark、Substack、Betterment、CarGurus、ADT、Panera Bread 和 McGraw Hill 的違規行為而產生的資訊。 BleepingComputer 證實，一些收件人的地址出現在引用的洩漏資料集中。詐騙者謊稱他們破壞了收件人的設備、攝影機和瀏覽活動。沒有證據支持這些設備受損的說法，ShinyHunters 否認參與了這項活動。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #ShinyHunters

posts.text: 🇫🇷 France — FFTA Database Allegedly Offered for Sale A threat actor is advertising an alleged database belonging to FFTA (Fédération Française de Tir à l'Arc) on an underground forum. * The listing claims to contain approximately 658,000 address records with postal addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, regions, municipalities, postal codes, and related metadata. * The actor also claims to possess account tables containing usernames, password hashes, authentication data, login information, and IP addresses. * Additional datasets allegedly include around 378,000 unique email addresses, 354,000 unique phone numbers, and more than 92,000 legal representative records. * The data collection date listed by the seller is July 25, 2026. posts.text: 🇪🇨 Ecuador — Libélula Soft & Nuvem Services Financial Platform Allegedly Compromised Libélula Soft and Nuvem Services, Ecuadorian software providers serving financial cooperatives, insurance organizations, and healthcare institutions, have allegedly been compromised. A threat actor claims to be selling database access, source infrastructure, and exploitation details on an underground forum. * The actor claims to be selling approximately 87 GB of data across 140 databases. * The listing alleges more than 40 million financial transaction records dating from 2023–2026. * The claimed dataset reportedly includes around 240,000 user records containing names, national ID numbers, phone numbers, email addresses, balances, loan information, and other financial data. * The actor also claims to provide SQL injection details, web shells, middleware bypass techniques, SSH private keys, and access to client databases associated with the Nuvem platform. Analyst Note: If authentic, this would represent a significant supply-chain compromise affecting multiple financial institutions rather than a single organization. The claims have not been independently verified, and no official confirmation has been issued at the time of writing. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Ecuador
posts.text_zh: 🇪🇨 厄瓜多爾 — Libélula Soft 和 Nuvem Services 金融平台據稱受到損害 為金融合作社、保險組織和醫療機構提供服務的厄瓜多爾軟體提供商 Libélula Soft 和 Nuvem Services 據稱已受到損害。威脅行為者聲稱在地下論壇上出售資料庫存取權限、來源基礎設施和利用詳細資訊。 * 該行為者聲稱正在出售 140 個資料庫中約 87 GB 的資料。 * 這份清單聲稱有超過 4,000 萬筆 2023 年至 2026 年的金融交易記錄。 * 據報道，聲稱的資料集包括約 240,000 條使用者記錄，其中包含姓名、身分證號碼、電話號碼、電子郵件地址、餘額、貸款資訊和其他財務資料。 * 該攻擊者還聲稱提供 SQL 注入詳細資訊、Web shell、中間件繞過技術、SSH 私鑰以及與 Nuvem 平台相關的客戶端資料庫的存取權。分析師註：如果屬實，這將代表重大的供應鏈妥協，影響多個金融機構而不是單一組織。這些說法尚未獨立核實，截至撰寫本文時尚未發布官方確認。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Ecuador

posts.text: 🇰🇵 North Korean Hackers Allegedly Robbed Their Own State Banks A group of former North Korean military cyber operators and elite IT graduates reportedly hacked the country’s Chosun Central Bank and Foreign Trade Bank for personal profit. * The group allegedly siphoned small amounts from state trade funds to avoid detection. * Stolen funds were reportedly converted into cryptocurrency and moved through overseas wallets. * Chinese brokers allegedly converted the crypto back into U.S. dollars and yuan. * North Korea’s National Intelligence Agency reportedly arrested the group during a July 12 raid in Pyongyang. Analyst Note: The report comes from Daily NK’s anonymous source network and has not been confirmed by North Korean authorities. If accurate, the case shows how state-developed cyber expertise can create serious insider risk when operators turn those capabilities against the regime itself. Source: Daily NK #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #NorthKorea
posts.text_zh: 🇰🇵 北韓駭客據稱搶劫了自己的國家銀行 據報道，一群前朝鮮軍事網路操作員和精英 IT 畢業生為個人利益入侵了該國的朝鮮中央銀行和外貿銀行。 * 據稱，該組織從國家貿易基金中挪用了少量資金以避免被發現。 * 據報道，被盜資金被轉換成加密貨幣並透過海外錢包轉移。 * 據稱中國經紀人將加密貨幣兌換回美元和人民幣。 * 據報道，北韓國家情報局在 7 月 12 日平壤的一次突襲中逮捕了該組織。分析師註：該報道來自Daily NK匿名來源網絡，尚未得到北韓當局證實。如果準確的話，該案例表明，當運營商將這些能力用於對抗政權本身時，國家開發的網路專業知識如何造成嚴重的內部風險。資料來源：Daily NK #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #NorthKorea

posts.name: DailyDarkWeb
posts.text: 🇳🇵 Nepal - Nepal Public Service Commission (PSC) Data Breach Exposes 1.6 Million Records The Nepal Public Service Commission (PSC), the constitutional body responsible for selecting candidates for government positions in Nepal, has allegedly been compromised. This incident follows a pattern of cyberattacks on various Nepali government entities where sensitive citizen data has been exposed and offered for sale on underground forums. The current incident reportedly involves the sale of a database containing 1.6 million records. Past incidents have seen data from other Public Service Commissions in Nepal also listed for sale. The allegedly compromised data includes: * Full names * Residential addresses * Phone numbers * Email addresses * Dates of birth * Citizenship numbers * Educational qualifications * Examination details * Applicant IDs * Password hashes #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Nepal
posts.text_zh: 🇳🇵尼泊爾 - 尼泊爾公共服務委員會 (PSC) 資料洩露，160 萬條記錄洩露 尼泊爾公共服務委員會 (PSC) 是負責挑選尼泊爾政府職位候選人的憲法機構，據稱已遭到洩露。此事件遵循針對尼泊爾各個政府實體的網路攻擊模式，其中敏感的公民資料被曝光並在地下論壇上出售。據報道，目前事件涉及出售包含 160 萬筆記錄的資料庫。在過去的事件中，尼泊爾其他公共服務委員會的數據也被掛牌出售。據稱洩露的資料包括： * 全名 * 居住地址 * 電話號碼 * 電子郵件地址 * 出生日期 * 公民號碼 * 教育資格 * 考試詳細資料 * 申請人 ID * 密碼雜湊 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Nepal

posts.name: DailyDarkWeb
posts.text: 🇺🇸 OnTrac confirms a customer-data breach following a corporate-network intrusion U.S. parcel-delivery company OnTrac began notifying customers that attackers breached its network and accessed files between March 20 and March 22, 2026. Names were exposed, but the public notification redacted the other affected data fields. OnTrac says it has not observed fraud or publication of the information and is offering identity-protection services. #DDW #USA #DataBreach #DarkWeb
posts.text_zh: 🇺🇸 OnTrac 確認公司網路入侵後發生客戶資料外洩美國包裹遞送公司 OnTrac 開始通知客戶，攻擊者在 2026 年 3 月 20 日至 3 月 22 日期間入侵了其網路並存取了檔案。名稱已被暴露，但公共通知編輯了其他受影響的資料欄位。 OnTrac 表示，尚未發現詐欺或資訊發布行為，並正在提供身分保護服務。 #DDW #USA #DataBreach #DarkWeb

posts.text: 🍞BAKING 🍞 I had a ton of people ask me about the super cool and badass malware sample my beloved colleague sent me. I also had a ton of people me to share more details on it. Here are some FAQ: 1. What does it do? It's an Information Stealer, but it's super fancy 2. Does it have a name? Yes, as of like, last Tuesday (I have no idea when it was named, I'm just talking shit). It's officially called RevStealer by my peers. There is limited information it at the moment. 3. How long have you been bonking it? I invested about 4 hours over the time span of a few days, I think. I wish I had more free time for bonkings, but I don't 4. Can you share it? Yes, I am sharing it now. I'm pushing it to prod now. It's under /Samples/Families/RevStealer. I encourage you to bonk it too. It's really cool and fun to explore. I haven't had enough time to explore it and appreciate it, but I enjoyed it. 5. Can you share hashes? Initial .zip: 251aa2b0831d88a6f796bb6ca01d0242c11476b2fc6a5baa3f9c64a9134cd61d Stage 1 (packer, stager): d23b9609b06ab23243543ee0d8ff0d4c1966530576fa37bb2ecde97309ebbc9e Stage 2 (in-memory payload): 724b400afcec2064a3477abd9a117103abfb51f7f7c8acd9c429fcdabd656ffc Decoy (maybe?): 851383fb22dcb1d16367839178271eef6504199b8ca60405e1698879696e49d4 6. Who is it attributed to? I have no idea. My colleagues have speculations, but nothing is solid yet. Pic unrelated (or maybe it is).
posts.text_zh: 🍞烘焙 🍞 很多人問我關於我心愛的同事發給我的超酷且糟糕的惡意軟體樣本的事。我還有很多人來分享更多細節。以下是一些常見問題： 1. 它有什麼作用？它是一個資訊竊取器，但它非常奇特 2. 它有名字嗎？是的，就像上週二一樣（我不知道它是什麼時候命名的，我只是在胡說八道）。我的同行將其正式稱為 RevStealer。目前資訊有限。 3. 你已經用了多久了？我想我在幾天的時間內投入了大約 4 個小時。我希望我有更多的空閒時間來玩，但我沒有 4. 你能分享一下嗎？是的，我現在正在分享。我現在正在將其推向生產環境。它位於 /Samples/Families/RevStealer 下。我鼓勵你也把它搞砸。探索真的很酷又有趣。我沒有足夠的時間去探索和欣賞它，但我很享受。 5. 可以分享一下雜湊值嗎？初始 .zip：251aa2b0831d88a6f796bb6ca01d0242c11476b2fc6a5baa3f9c64a9134cd61d 第 1 階段（打包器、stager）： d23b9609b06ab23243543ee0d8ff0d4c1966530576fa37bb2ecde97309ebbc9e 第 2 階段（記憶體中負載）： 724b400afcec2064a3477abd9a117103abfb51f7f7c8acd9c429fcdabd656ffc 誘餌（也許？）： 851383fb22dcb1d16367839178271eef6504199b8ca60405e1698879696e49d4 6. 歸屬於誰？我不知道。我的同事們有各種猜測，但目前還沒有任何證據。圖片無關（或者也許是）。

posts.text: 🚨🇺🇸🇺🇸🇩🇪 Root CMS access to three major companies allegedly listed for sale A forum actor claims to be selling privileged CMS access tied to two unnamed US pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies and the German rail-freight division of a national railway. The three organizations reportedly generate approximately $84.4 billion in combined annual revenue. The listings advertise root access to 18 CMS instances, including systems distributed across 10 countries. The seller claims the access provides full read and write capabilities, including access to records, user account creation, file uploads, and email creation. Asking prices are listed at $16,000 for the biotechnology company, $40,000 for the pharmaceutical company, and $12,000 for the rail-freight operator. This claim is currently unverified.
posts.text_zh: 🚨🇺🇸🇺🇸🇩🇪 涉嫌出售的三大公司的根 CMS 訪問權限 一名論壇參與者聲稱正在出售與兩家未具名的美國製藥和生物技術公司以及德國國家鐵路的鐵路貨運部門相關的特權 CMS 訪問權限。據報道，這三個組織的年收入合計約為 844 億美元。這些清單宣傳對 18 個 CMS 實例的根存取權限，其中包括分佈在 10 個國家/地區的系統。賣家聲稱該存取權限提供了完整的讀寫功能，包括存取記錄、建立使用者帳戶、文件上傳和建立電子郵件。生技公司的要價為 16,000 美元，製藥公司的要價為 40,000 美元，鐵路貨運業者的要價為 12,000 美元。目前這一說法尚未得到證實。

posts.text: 🚨🇳🇱 Netherlands contact dataset containing 14 million records allegedly listed for sale A forum actor claims to be selling a 2026 dataset containing approximately 14 million records tied to individuals in the Netherlands. This claim is currently unverified.

posts.text: 🚨🇫🇷 Three French fire and rescue services allegedly targeted in separate data leaks Forum actors ChimeraZ and Cybernox claim to have leaked data tied to SDIS 06 in Alpes-Maritimes, SDIS 40 in Landes, and SDIS 04 in Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. The SDIS 06 listing advertises 2,331 records covering 2,325 people and 15,833 files totaling 22.5GB. The SDIS 40 post references 241 records and 3,205 files totaling 11.8GB, while the SDIS 04 listing advertises 145 personnel records. The allegedly exposed information includes firefighters’ names, dates of birth, nationalities, ranks, assignments, email addresses, phone numbers, home addresses, biographies, internal operational material, and other private documents. These claims are currently unverified.
posts.text_zh: 🚨🇫🇷 據稱分別針對資料外洩的三個法國消防和救援服務 論壇參與者 ChimeraZ 和 Cyber​​nox 聲稱洩露了與濱海阿爾卑斯省的 SDIS 06、朗德省的 SDIS 40 和上普羅旺斯阿爾卑斯省的 SDIS 04 相關的資料。 SDIS 06 清單公佈了 2,331 筆記錄，涵蓋 2,325 個人和 15,833 個文件，總計 22.5GB。 SDIS 40 貼文引用了 241 筆記錄和 3,205 個文件，總計 11.8GB，而 SDIS 04 清單則公佈了 145 筆人事記錄。據稱暴露的資訊包括消防員的姓名、出生日期、國籍、軍階、任務、電子郵件地址、電話號碼、家庭住址、傳記、內部運作資料和其他私人文件。這些說法目前尚未得到證實。

posts.text: 🚨🇫🇷 SDIS de la Marne personnel data and documents allegedly leaked Forum actors ChimeraZ and Cybernox claim to have leaked a database and document archive tied to SDIS 51, the fire and rescue service for France’s Marne department. The post advertises 2,168 records covering 2,167 individuals, along with 1,021 files totaling approximately 700MB. The actors say the archive contains 1,020 documents related to firefighters and the organization’s website, provided in CSV and PDF formats. The allegedly exposed information includes personnel names, work email addresses, phone numbers, job titles, departmental roles, and firefighter-related documents. This claim is currently unverified.

posts.text: 🚨🌐 Coinbase session cookie checker and account takeover service advertised on a cybercrime forum A forum actor is advertising a bot that allegedly checks stolen Coinbase session cookies for account balances, provides access without valid email credentials, and supports rapid withdrawals using methods designed to evade antifraud systems. The listing also advertises 2FA removal for Coinbase, MEXC, Kraken, Bybit, and other cryptocurrency exchanges. The seller says personally sourced material is required and prioritizes stealer logs, macOS logs, RDP access, hVNC, and botnet data. Accounts from the US and UK must reportedly hold at least $1,000, while accounts from Europe and other regions require balances of at least $8,000. Revenue-sharing terms of 60/40 and 50/50 are advertised depending on the account balance. This claim is currently unverified.
posts.text_zh: 🚨🌐 網路犯罪論壇上宣傳的 Coinbase 會話 cookie 檢查器和帳戶接管服務 一名論壇演員正在宣傳一款機器人，據稱該機器人可以檢查被盜的 Coinbase 會話 cookie 的帳戶餘額，無需有效的電子郵件憑證即可提供訪問權限，並支持使用旨在逃避反欺詐系統的方法進行快速提款。該清單還宣傳了 Coinbase、MEXC、Kraken、Bybit 和其他加密貨幣交易所的 2FA 刪除。賣家表示需要個人來源的資料，並優先考慮竊取者日誌、macOS 日誌、RDP 存取、hVNC 和殭屍網路資料。據報道，美國和英國的帳戶必須持有至少 1,000 美元，而歐洲和其他地區的帳戶則要求餘額至少為 8,000 美元。根據帳戶餘額公佈 60/40 和 50/50 的收益分享條款。目前這一說法尚未得到證實。

posts.text: 🚨🇻🇪 RDP access to unnamed Venezuelan equipment supplier allegedly listed for sale on a Russian speaking forum A forum actor claims to be selling remote access to the network of a Venezuelan company that supplies industrial, agricultural, and household equipment. The listing says the company has operated for more than 27 years, works with over 600 distributors, and maintains 20 authorized service centers. Its revenue is estimated at between 10 million and 25 million, although no currency was specified. The advertised access allegedly includes an Active Directory user account on a Windows Server 2012 R2 system, Radmin VPN and AnyDesk connectivity, access to networked computers, and approximately 2TB of data. Bitdefender is reportedly installed on the environment. This claim is currently unverified.
posts.text_zh: 🚨🇻🇪 據稱在俄語論壇上出售的未具名委內瑞拉設備供應商的 RDP 訪問權限 一名論壇演員聲稱正在出售對一家供應工業、農業和家用設備的委內瑞拉公司網絡的遠程訪問權限。清單顯示，該公司已營運超過 27 年，與 600 多家經銷商合作，並擁有 20 個授權服務中心。其收入估計在 1000 萬至 2500 萬之間，但沒有具體說明貨幣。據稱，所公佈的存取權限包括 Windows Server 2012 R2 系統上的 Active Directory 使用者帳戶、Radmin VPN 和 AnyDesk 連線、對連網電腦的存取權限以及大約 2TB 的資料。據報道，環境中安裝了 Bitdefender。目前這一說法尚未得到證實。

posts.text: 🚨🇸🇦 GulfJobs[.]com recruitment dataset containing approximately 872,000 records allegedly listed for sale A forum actor claims to be selling data tied to GulfJobs[.]com, a Saudi recruitment platform connecting employers with job candidates. The listing advertises approximately 872,000 entity and metadata records covering candidate contacts, profiles, job applications, authentication logs, and third-party platform mappings. The allegedly exposed information includes names, email addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth, genders, nationalities, home addresses, marital statuses, emergency contacts, passport details, employment histories, skills, salaries, police clearance certificates, résumés, physical attributes, disability information, application statuses, interview results, background checks, visa statuses, and onboarding records. posts.text: 🚨 New msaRAT Malware Hides C2 Traffic Inside Chrome and Edge Cisco Talos has uncovered msaRAT, a Rust-based backdoor used in attacks linked to the Chaos ransomware group. * The malware launches Chrome or Edge in headless mode and controls it through the Chrome DevTools Protocol. * Cloudflare Workers handles the initial WebRTC signaling. * Twilio TURN servers relay the command-and-control traffic, concealing the attacker’s real IP address. * Communications are protected by WebRTC DTLS plus ChaCha20-Poly1305 and ECDH encryption. * The payload is delivered through an MSI installer disguised as a Microsoft update. Analyst Note: msaRAT turns trusted browser and cloud infrastructure into a covert C2 channel. Defenders may see traffic to legitimate Cloudflare and Twilio services rather than direct connections to attacker-controlled servers, significantly complicating network-based detection. Source: Cisco Talos #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Malware
posts.text_zh: 🚨 新的 msaRAT 惡意軟體隱藏 Chrome 和 Edge 內部的 C2 流量 Cisco Talos 發現了 msaRAT，這是一種基於 Rust 的後門，用於與 Chaos 勒索軟體組織相關的攻擊。 * 此惡意軟體以無頭模式啟動 Chrome 或 Edge，並透過 Chrome DevTools 協定對其進行控制。 * Cloudflare Workers 處理初始 WebRTC 訊號。 * Twilio TURN 伺服器中繼指令與控制流量，隱藏攻擊者的真實 IP 位址。 * 通訊受到 WebRTC DTLS 以及 ChaCha20-Poly1305 和 ECDH 加密的保護。 * 有效負載透過偽裝成 Microsoft 更新的 MSI 安裝程式提供。分析師註釋：msaRAT 將受信任的瀏覽器和雲端基礎設施轉變為隱藏的 C2 通道。防禦者可能會看到流向合法 Cloudflare 和 Twilio 服務的流量，而不是直接連接到攻擊者控制的伺服器，這使得基於網路的偵測變得非常複雜。資料來源：思科 Talos #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Malware

posts.text: 🚨 INC Ransom Affiliate Used AI-Assisted Tooling to Target ESXi and NAS Systems Ctrl-Alt-Intel researchers uncovered an exposed operator directory linked to an active INC Ransom intrusion against a Chinese technology company. * Compromised Microsoft 365 and VPN accounts were used to map the environment. * More than 50 Python scripts targeted Active Directory, VMware, storage, backups and cloud data. * The affiliate extracted NTDS.dit and registry hives before targeting vCenter, ESXi and NAS infrastructure. * NAS shares were mounted to a Windows pivot and encrypted using the INC ransomware payload. * Researchers assess that an LLM generated or modified much of the operational tooling. Analyst Note: AI did not replace the attacker’s technical knowledge. It accelerated experimentation by turning operational questions into disposable scripts for credential theft, lateral movement, management-plane compromise and ransomware deployment. Source: Ctrl-Alt-Intel: https://ctrlaltintel.com/research/INC-Ransom/ #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Ransomware

posts.text: 🚨 Russian State-Backed Hackers Exploit Zimbra Flaw to Steal Emails The United States and international partners have issued a joint advisory warning that the Russian state-supported group LAUNDRY BEAR has targeted government and commercial organizations using Zimbra Collaboration Suite since at least July 2025. * The campaign exploits CVE-2025-66376, a cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting Zimbra’s Classic UI. * Victims may be compromised simply by opening or previewing a malicious email—without clicking a link or attachment. * The operation initially targeted organizations in Ukraine before expanding to the United States and other NATO countries. * Targeted sectors include government, defense, energy, education, law enforcement, media, NGOs, and technology. Organizations should immediately update Zimbra, review historical email activity and investigate suspicious messages that may have delivered malicious JavaScript payloads. Analyst Note: The campaign demonstrates how quickly state-backed actors can operationalize zero-day vulnerabilities against widely deployed email infrastructure. Patching alone may not be sufficient where exploitation occurred before remediation. Source: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory AA26-204A issued by CISA, NSA, FBI and international partners. https://media.defense.gov/2026/Jul/22/2003965244/-1/-1/0/CSA_RUSSIA_PHISHING_TARGET_ZIMBRA.PDF #DDW #Intelligence #Cybersecurity #Zimbra

posts.text: I've praised a few malwares for various reasons. However, this particular malware is very interesting. - Initially masquerading malware, designed to target very specific audience - Written in multiple programming languages. However, the first stage is written in an uncommon programming language (Delphi) and compiled using an uncommon compiler (Embarcadero), specifically Delphi GUI TForm from Embarcadero (Vcl?) - Obfuscated, in a very natural way. The binary at first glance appears semi-legitimate, it hides itself well - The first stage (stager, or packer) contains multiple layers of decoy data. It makes reverse engineering challenging, not due to difficulty but time exhaustion - Secondary stage (where I'm currently at) is loaded into memory discretely, it flows naturally with the GUI application. When decompiled, the stager has over 15,000 functions. It makes finding the in-memory loaded secondary stage tricky - The secondary stage has some form of interprocess communication, it relies on the first stage to load it. If the first stage is not present, it does not work. - The second stage works (in a currently unknown capacity) to load a third stage payload. However, the secondary stage with the first stage work (in a currently unknown way) to decrypt the third (and potentially final) stage a/k/a the actual payload - The second stage uses deterministic probability to alert the first stage if the machine executing the first stage is a virtual machine and/or anti malware environment. - The second stage has multiple integrity checks, it ensures it has not been tampered with to force the binary to pull the third and final stage. This malware is pretty tricky. It definitely hasn't been written by a noob. This is definitely a very skilled Threat Actor who is using AI to supercharge their code base. Based on my conversations with my colleague, and information he can share, this code base has been rapidly evolving over the past couple of months in a uncharacteristic manner. While this Threat Actor has always shown evolution and improvement, it is now much faster, precise, and flexible. Overall, based on what I've seen so far, they've put in a lot of work to make this as painful as possible. In order to successfully reverse engineer this binary, it require outside the box thinking and/or building a custom solution to successfully trick the secondary stager to give up the goop (the third stage)... or a custom extractor to pull the third stage statically. No solution is ideal. This is good malware. If it's not state-sponsored, it's someone who has been doing this a long time and knows ball.
posts.text_zh: 我出於各種原因讚揚了一些惡意軟體。然而，這個特殊的惡意軟體非常有趣。 - 最初偽裝惡意軟體，旨在針對非常特定的受眾 - 用多種程式語言編寫。然而，第一階段是用不常見的程式語言（Delphi）編寫的，並使用不常見的編譯器（Embarcadero）進行編譯，特別是來自 Embarcadero 的 Delphi GUI TForm（Vcl？） - 以非常自然的方式進行模糊處理。乍一看，二進位檔案似乎是半合法的，它很好地隱藏了自己 - 第一階段（stager 或 packer）包含多層誘餌資料。它使逆向工程變得具有挑戰性，不是因為困難，而是因為時間耗盡 - 第二階段（我目前所處的位置）被離散地加載到記憶體中，它自然地與 GUI 應用程式一起流動。反編譯後，stager 具有超過 15,000 個函數。這使得查找記憶體中載入的輔助階段變得棘手 - 輔助階段具有某種形式的進程間通信，它依賴第一階段來載入它。如果第一階段不存在，則它不起作用。 - 第二級工作（目前未知的能力）裝載第三級有效載荷。然而，第二階段與第一階段一起工作（以當前未知的方式）來解密第三階段（可能是最終階段）a/k/a實際有效負載 - 如果執行第一階段的機器是虛擬機和/或反惡意軟體環境，第二階段使用確定性機率來警告第一階段。 - 第二階段有多個完整性檢查，它確保它沒有被篡改以強制二進位檔案拉動第三階段和最後階段。這個惡意軟體非常棘手。這絕對不是菜鳥寫的。這絕對是一個非常熟練的威脅行為者，他正在使用人工智慧來增強他們的程式碼庫。根據我與同事的對話以及他可以分享的訊息，這個程式碼庫在過去幾個月中以一種不尋常的方式迅速發展。雖然這個威脅行為者一直在不斷發展和改進，但現在它更快、更精確、更靈活。總的來說，根據我迄今為止所看到的情況，他們投入了大量的工作來讓這件事變得盡可能痛苦。為了成功地對這個二進位檔案進行逆向工程，它需要跳出框框思考和/或建立一個自訂解決方案來成功欺騙二級階段器放棄goop（第三階段）......或者一個自訂提取器來靜態拉動第三階段。沒有一種解決方案是理想的。這是一個很好的惡意軟體。如果不是國家資助的，那麼這個人就是已經做了很長時間並且了解球的人。

posts.text: > wake up > take a shit > get out of bed > remember colleagues hardcore malware thingie > download > look inside > confused.mp4 > regular .exe, but has .exe inside of it > bonk with stick > .exe inside of it is the same .exe > .exe has itself inside of itself > only small difference > cant tell difference > confusion_intensifies.mp5 > has anti-vm code > cant get to work in emulation > written using delphi > delphi tform GUI thingy > weird af de-compilation > 16,000 functions present > most do basic stuff, like add or subtract > staticly links a bunch of random libraries > LOLWTF WHO WROTE THIS > bonk with really big stick > eventually find some good goop > new .exe randomly appears in-memory > ??? > grab from memory > c++ .exe, staticly linked > 500 functions > heavily obfuscated > has anti-code tampering in place > ??? > this in-memory .exe references 1st .exe goop > ask colleague about goop > "We discovered this Threat Actor likely created their own custom .exe encryptor and decryptor" I've been bonking this malware with a stick for over an hour, I think, maybe two hours. I've been able to grab an in-memory mapped PE file which the original .exe loads into memory. However, I am unable to determine precisely where this PE file is mapped exactly because it's a Delphi TForm application, its statically linked, and is intentionally obfuscated. This secondary .exe loaded into memory has tamper protection, patching it to force itself to give me more malware won't be easy. This binary also has anti-VM features as well, I think from calculating disk space. However, I can't tell right now either, but this is what it appears like based on the API it imports. 1. Delphi TForm application 2. Does stuff, lots of junk 3. Maps secondary PE into memory (somehow) 4. Secondary PE does recon to assess the machine 5. ??? Somewhere in the midst of this, this binary is going to make an external call, somewhere, somehow, but it's proven to be difficult due to how obfuscated this code is, coupled with the custom PE cryptor, decoy data present, ... and everything else. Initially I was under the impression one of the obvious .EXEs I saw was the actual secondary payload, but it's not (I think?), it appears to be a decoy (I think). I don't know who wrote this, but this is probably one of the most sophisticated malware payloads I've seen in recent time. It has successfully evaded my VM, RecordedFuture Triage, VirusTotal VM, and AnyRun I still don't know what this malware is trying to do.

Delphi TForm 應用程式 2. 做東西，很多垃圾 3. 將輔助 PE 映射到記憶體（以某種方式） 4. 輔助 PE 進行偵察以評估機器 5. ???在這中間的某個地方，這個二進位檔案將在某個地方、以某種方式進行外部調用，但事實證明，由於該程式碼的混淆量，加上自定義程式碼，加上其他的數據最初，我的印像是我看到的一個明顯的 .EXE 是實際的輔助有效負載，但它不是（我認為？），它似乎是一個誘餌（我認為）。我不知道是誰寫的，但這可能是我最近見過的最複雜的惡意軟體有效負載之一。它已成功逃避我的 VM、RecordedFuture Triage、VirusTotal VM 和 AnyRun 我仍然不知道該惡意軟體想要做什麼。

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged BlaBlaCar Breach Exposes 140M User Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that a database containing 140 million user records from BlaBlaCar, the French carpooling and travel platform, has been leaked. The listing, posted under the title "BlaBlaCar 140M," alleges the exposure of sensitive personal and account data for users across multiple countries. According to the sample data provided in the thread, the alleged dump includes a wide range of personally identifiable information (PII) and account details. The exposed fields reportedly include: * User IDs and email addresses * Password hashes (bcrypt format) * Full names and gender * Phone numbers and verification statuses * Geographic data (country, city) * Account activity metrics (rides as driver/passenger, ratings, wallet balances) * Vehicle information (make and model) * App version and signup platform BlaBlaCar is a significant player in the European mobility sector, operating in over 22 countries and serving tens of millions of active members annually. The company connects drivers with empty seats to passengers traveling in the same direction. If authentic, the exposure of password hashes and phone numbers could facilitate credential stuffing attacks or targeted phishing campaigns against its user base. At the time of reporting, BlaBlaCar has not issued a public statement regarding this specific incident, and the breach has not been independently verified by third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 涉嫌 BlaBlaCar 洩露在暗網上洩露了 1.4 億用戶記錄 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱，法國拼車和旅行平台 BlaBlaCar 包含 1.4 億用戶記錄的數據庫已被洩露。該清單以「BlaBlaCar 140M」為標題發布，聲稱多個國家/地區的用戶的敏感個人和帳戶資料遭到洩露。根據線程中提供的樣本數據，所謂的轉儲包括廣泛的個人識別資訊 (PII) 和帳戶詳細資訊。根據報告，暴露的欄位包括： * 用戶 ID 和電子郵件地址 * 密碼雜湊（bcrypt 格式） * 全名和性別 * 電話號碼和驗證狀態 * 地理資料（國家、城市） * 帳戶活動指標（司機/乘客乘車、評級、錢包餘額） * 車輛資訊（品牌和型號） * 應用程式版本和平台版本和平台每年都超過 2 個行動裝置的重要領域。該公司將空座的司機與同向行駛的乘客連接起來。如果是真實的，密碼雜湊值和電話號碼的暴露可能會促進針對其用戶群的撞庫攻擊或有針對性的網路釣魚活動。截至發稿時，BlaBlaCar 尚未就這一具體事件發表公開聲明，該漏洞尚未得到第三方安全研究人員的獨立驗證。

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Database Dump of China's Army Engineering University Exposes 32,797 Records A post on an underground forum claims to have dumped a database containing personal information of faculty and students from the Army Engineering University of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) in China. The listing alleges that 32,797 records were extracted from the institution's systems, associated with the domain http://aeu.edu.cn. According to the post, the leaked dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and military-specific identifiers. The exposed data fields reportedly include: * Full names * Roles (e.g., student, teacher) * Military codes * Sexuality/Gender * Partial email addresses * Partial phone numbers * Academic departments The Army Engineering University of the PLA is a significant military educational institution responsible for training engineering and technical personnel for the Chinese military. The exposure of military codes and internal roles could potentially aid in social engineering attacks or intelligence gathering against current and former personnel. Samples provided in the thread show CSV-formatted entries with student IDs, names, and status markers such as "Unverified" (未认证). The actor behind the leak has offered the full dataset for sale via direct message on Telegram. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from the PLA or the university.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of SEKISUI Aerospace ITAR Data on Darkweb A darkweb forum post alleges the theft and sale of 70 GB of sensitive engineering data belonging to SEKISUI Aerospace Corporation, a U.S.-based Tier 1 supplier for major defense contractors. The actor claims to possess export-controlled technical data, including engineering drawings, STEP files, and bills of materials related to Boeing 737 and 787 programs, as well as components for NASA, Lockheed Martin, and Northrop Grumman. According to the listing, the stolen package contains highly specific technical artifacts marked as “EXPORT CONTROLLED – EAR 9E991 / ITAR Technical Data.” The post enumerates the following contents: • Technical PDF files containing engineering drawings • Complete STEP files in AP242 format for CATIA V5-6R2022 and SolidWorks 2018–2024 • Full Bills of Materials with authentic Boeing part numbers • Complete tooling and fixture data for the Boeing 737 MAX Keel Skin Splice Strap, Boeing 787 Section 41 Nose, and interior panel assemblies • Material specifications including carbon fiber prepreg, thermoplastic PEI and PPS, aluminum 6061-T6, and titanium inserts • Tolerances down to ±0.0005 inch with GD&T in accordance with ASME Y14.5 • Three-dimensional models of assembly tools including drill jigs, trim fixtures, bonding fixtures, and all related bushings and locator hardware with real Carr Lane and McMaster-Carr part numbers • Process specification documents compliant with Boeing BAC requirements The threat actor is reportedly asking for $200,000 USD for the data, stating that the price can be negotiated. The data allegedly includes precision assembly tooling and thermoplastic components used in fuselage, wing, keel beam, and interior structures. Because the materials are subject to strict U.S. export controls under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), their unauthorized disclosure could carry significant legal and national security implications for the affected entities. SEKISUI Aerospace Corporation is a subsidiary of Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd., a major Japanese chemical manufacturer. As a direct supplier to Boeing and other critical defense primes, the company plays a vital role in the aerospace supply chain. If authentic, exposure of internal repositories could enable intellectual property theft and infrastructure targeting. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified. #DataBreach #SEKISUIAerospace #ITAR #Boeing #DefenseIndustry #DarkWeb #CyberSecurity

posts.text: ⚠️ Threat Actor Claims Sale of 176M Starbucks User Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor is offering a database containing 176 million unique Starbucks user records for sale. The seller claims to have successfully extracted the data in June 2026 and is listing the database for $400. The post includes sample lines demonstrating the breadth of the alleged breach, which reportedly spans multiple countries including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, France, Germany, and Spain. According to the listing, the exposed dataset contains highly sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and financial details. The sample data provided in the thread indicates the following fields are included: * user_id * email * password_hash (bcrypt format) * name * country_code and country * city * created_at and last_activity_at * account_status * email_verified * birthday * stars_balance and stars_lifetime * total_spent * currency_code * starbucks_card_number * card_balance * auto_reload_enabled * favorite_store_number * favorite_drink * mobile_orders_count * free_rewards_redeemed * signup_platform Starbucks is one of the world's largest coffeehouse chains, with over 38,000 stores globally and a massive digital loyalty program. The exposure of such a large volume of user data, including hashed passwords and linked payment card numbers, could facilitate credential stuffing attacks, identity theft, and targeted phishing campaigns against customers. If authentic, the inclusion of specific spending habits and favorite drinks adds a layer of personalization that could enhance social engineering efforts. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Starbucks or third-party security researchers. The company has not issued any public statements regarding this specific incident. #DataBreach #Starbucks #DarkWeb #PII #CredentialLeak #CyberSecurity #RetailSecurity

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 90M Just Eat Records Leaked on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that a database containing 90 million records from Just Eat has been exposed. The actor alleges that the data belongs to Just Eat http://Takeaway.com, the multinational food delivery platform that operates across Europe and other regions. The post includes a sample of the alleged dump, which appears to contain user credentials and financial details. According to the listing, the exposed dataset includes the following fields: * user_id * email * password_hash (bcrypt format) * name * country * currency_code * account_type * member_since * email_verified * payment_method * card_last4 (last four digits of credit/debit cards) * payout_method * platform and app_version * last_active timestamp * account_status The sample records provided in the thread show users from various countries, including the US, UK, Spain, France, Canada, Italy, and Mexico. The entries include full names, email addresses, hashed passwords, and partial payment card numbers. Some records also indicate donation histories and campaign details, which may suggest the data originates from a crowdfunding or donation feature associated with the platform or a related service. Just Eat http://Takeaway.com is one of the largest food delivery companies globally, with millions of active users. If authentic, the exposure of 90 million user records including password hashes and payment card fragments could facilitate credential stuffing attacks, phishing campaigns, and identity theft. The bcrypt hashes are computationally expensive to crack but remain vulnerable if users have reused weak passwords. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Just Eat http://Takeaway.com or third-party security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 LAPSUS$-Branded Site Announces “Permanent” Shutdown A website presenting itself as official LAPSUS$ infrastructure has published a PGP-signed message claiming the extortion group is permanently ending all operations. * The statement says the group achieved its financial objectives. * It claims there will be no further leaks, communications, or access sales. * The message also mocks investigators and other cybercrime actors. * The identity of the site’s current operators has not been independently verified. Analyst Note: Cybercrime groups frequently announce retirements before rebranding, fragmenting, or returning under new infrastructure. Until the PGP signature and operators behind lapsus[.]bz are independently authenticated, this should be treated as a claimed shutdown—not definitive proof that LAPSUS$ activity has ended. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #LAPSUS

posts.text: Yesterday I was experimenting with using X articles for sharing malware bonkings. People wanted me to be slightly more verbose, primarily out of curiosity. It was cool. However, for reasons I don't understand, the X algorithm doesn't do much for highlighting articles. I was under the impression they wanted people to write articles. When I used their article thingie my engagement was through the floor. I don't understand how any of this works. Regardless, with X articles it isolates the homies on Telegram (they're probably all criminals, I don't know, Telegram nerds are schizos). Moving forward I'll probably just link to my goofy ass blog. It'll also make it easier for people to find it in the future (if they even care). I'm aiming to make them short, entertaining, and (hopefully) educational. Thank you to the people who continue to send me free malware. It is cool and badass.
posts.text_zh: 昨天我正在嘗試使用 X 文章來分享惡意軟體。人們希望我說得更詳細一點，主要是出於好奇。很酷。然而，由於我不明白的原因，X 演算法對於突出顯示文章沒有多大作用。我的印像是他們希望人們寫文章。當我使用他們的文章時，我的參與度很高。我不明白這是如何運作的。無論如何，X 篇文章將 Telegram 上的朋友們隔離開來（他們可能都是罪犯，我不知道，Telegram 書呆子都是精神分裂症患者）。展望未來，我可能只會連結到我愚蠢的部落格。它還將使人們將來更容易找到它（如果他們關心的話）。我的目標是讓它們簡短、有趣並且（希望）具有教育意義。感謝那些繼續向我發送免費惡意軟體的人。它很酷而且很酷。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Live Admin Access to Brazil's 300M-Record Health Database A post on an underground forum alleges that a threat actor has obtained live administrative access to Brazil’s national health and medical registry, purportedly containing over 300 million records. The listing claims the actor possesses full privileges to query, view, edit, and modify patient data in real-time, including residential addresses, family linkages, and complete historical vaccination records. According to the forum post, the actor is offering this access for sale at a price of $200, payable in Bitcoin, Monero, or Ethereum. The capabilities listed in the advertisement include: * Instant querying of the entire population by name, CPF (Brazilian individual taxpayer registry), state, and other identifiers * Access to full patient profiles with residential addresses and maternal/paternal linkage data * Complete historical vaccination records * Full administrative control to view, edit, and modify records in real-time The Brazilian Ministry of Health manages one of the largest public healthcare systems in the world through the Unified Health System (SUS), which serves the entire population of approximately 215 million people. The alleged exposure of such granular personal health information on a national scale would represent a significant privacy violation if the claims are authentic. If verified, the ability to modify medical records could have severe implications for public health tracking and individual patient care. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach and the authenticity of the claimed administrative access have not been independently verified by security researchers or official authorities. #DataBreach #Brazil #HealthcareSecurity #DarkWeb #PII #Ransomware #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 300M Uber User Records on Darkweb A post on an underground forum alleges the exposure of a database containing over 300 million Uber user records, which the actor is reportedly offering for sale. The listing, dated July 17, 2026, claims to include sensitive personal information for both riders and drivers across multiple countries. According to the post, the dataset includes the following fields: * user_id * email * password_hash (bcrypt) * name * phone * gender * city and country * account_type (rider/driver) * rating and total_trips * member_since and last_trip_at * payment_method and card_last4 * platform and app_version * account_status * vehicle_make, vehicle_model, vehicle_year, vehicle_class * license_plate * driver_license_no * driver_status * lifetime_earnings_usd The sample data provided in the thread shows entries from users in the United States, France, Mexico, Brazil, Spain, and the United Kingdom. For driver accounts, the alleged leak includes personally identifiable information such as license plate numbers, driver license numbers, and lifetime earnings in USD. Rider accounts allegedly contain email addresses, hashed passwords, phone numbers, and the last four digits of payment cards. Uber Technologies Inc. is a major global ride-hailing and delivery platform with hundreds of millions of active users worldwide. A breach of this scale would represent a significant compromise of user privacy and potentially expose financial data if password hashes are cracked or if card details are misused. The actor claims the complete dataset is available for $500 via a private messaging session. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Uber or third-party security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 95M Uber Eats User Records Leaked on Darkweb A post on an underground forum alleges the exposure of over 95 million user records from Uber Eats, the food delivery arm of Uber. The listing claims to contain a comprehensive database of customer and courier information, including personally identifiable information (PII), financial details, and behavioral data. According to the sample data provided in the thread, the alleged leak includes the following fields: * User IDs, emails, and password hashes (bcrypt) * Full names, phone numbers, and genders * Detailed delivery addresses, including city, postal code, country, and GPS coordinates * Payment method types and last four digits of credit cards * Account activity metrics such as total orders, average order value, and favorite cuisines * Courier-specific data including vehicle type, delivery counts, ratings, and earnings The sample entries appear to cover users from multiple countries, including the United States, Brazil, Mexico, the United Kingdom, France, Spain, and Italy. The data reportedly spans account creation dates from as early as 2015 to recent activity in 2025. If authentic, the exposure of such granular location and financial data could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns, identity theft, and physical security risks for both customers and delivery drivers. Uber is a multinational technology company operating in more than 70 countries. A breach of this scale would represent a significant incident for the organization, potentially triggering regulatory scrutiny under GDPR and other data protection laws due to the inclusion of EU citizen data. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Uber or third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱 9500 萬 Uber Eats 用戶記錄在暗網上洩露 地下論壇上的一篇帖子聲稱，Uber 的食品配送部門 Uber Eats 超過 9500 萬條用戶記錄被洩露。該清單聲稱包含客戶和快遞資訊的綜合資料庫，包括個人識別資訊（PII）、財務詳細資訊和行為資料。根據帖子中提供的樣本數據，涉嫌洩露的數據包括以下字段： * 用戶 ID、電子郵件和密碼哈希值 (bcrypt) * 全名、電話號碼和性別 * 詳細的送貨地址，包括城市、郵政編碼、國家和 GPS 坐標 * 付款方式類型和信用卡的最後四位數字 * 賬戶活動範例條目似乎涵蓋了用戶來自多個國家，包括美國、巴西、墨西哥、英國、法國、西班牙和義大利。據報道，這些數據涵蓋了從 2015 年創建帳戶到 2025 年最近活動的數據。如果真實，此類精細位置和財務資料的暴露可能會促進有針對性的網路釣魚活動、身份盜竊以及給客戶和送貨司機帶來的人身安全風險。 Uber 是一家跨國科技公司，業務遍及 70 多個國家。違反此規模將對該組織構成重大事件，由於包含歐盟公民數據，可能會引發 GDPR 和其他資料保護法的監管審查。截至本報告發佈時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到 Uber 或第三方安全研究人員的獨立核實。

posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Group-IB identified at least 12 compromised systems carrying #HOLLOWGRAPH, with only three actively communicating with attacker infrastructure during the observation period. The limited victim count, combined with Israeli-linked infrastructure and telemetry, suggests a highly targeted espionage operation rather than broad opportunistic #malware deployment.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @GroupIB_TI：Group-IB 識別出至少 12 個具有 #HOLLOWGRAPH 的受感染系統，其中在觀察期間只有 3 個系統主動與攻擊者基礎設施進行通訊。有限的受害者數量，加上與以色列相關的基礎設施和遙測技術，表明這是一次高度針對性的間諜活動，而不是廣泛的機會主義#惡意軟體部署。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: HOLLOWGRAPH supports only two commands, "get" and "send", yet maintains persistence of its cloud communications through DNS tunneling. Using specially crafted IPv6 AAAA queries to cloudlanecdn[.]com, the malware refreshes Microsoft Entra ID credentials required to authenticate to its Microsoft Graph-based C2 channel. #MalwareAnalysis
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：HOLLOWGRAPH 僅支援兩個命令“獲取”和“發送”，但透過 DNS 隧道保持其雲端通訊的持久性。此惡意軟體使用特製的 IPv6 AAAA 查詢 cloudlanecdn[.]com，刷新對基於 Microsoft Graph 的 C2 通道進行身份驗證所需的 Microsoft Entra ID 憑證。 #惡意軟體分析

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Instead of using traditional C2 infrastructure, #HOLLOWGRAPH stores operator tasking and stolen data inside calendar events scheduled for 13 May 2050. The implant retrieves commands from encrypted attachments and uploads exfiltrated files back to the same mailbox as File{n}.txt attachments, using separate RSA key pairs and AES-256-GCM encryption for each communication direction. Defenders should hunt for calendar events with Event ID: <taskid> {} subjects or the Boss{}ID{} naming convention. #ThreatIntel #APT
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#HOLLOWGRAPH 不使用傳統的 C2 基礎設施，而是將操作員任務和被盜資料儲存在計畫於 2050 年 5 月 13 日的日曆事件中。植入程式從加密附件中檢索命令，並將洩漏的檔案上傳回與 File{n}.txt 附件相同的郵箱，每個通訊方向使用單獨的 RSA 金鑰對和 AES-256-GCM 加密。防禦者應尋找具有事件 ID 的日曆事件：<taskid> {} 主題或 Boss{}ID{} 命名約定。 #威脅英特爾#APT

posts.text: ⚠️ When two "medium-looking" vulnerabilities meet, the outcome isn't always medium. The recently disclosed wp2shell chain is a good example of why vulnerabilities should be evaluated as attack paths rather than isolated CVEs. A REST API authorization bypass (CVE-2026-63030) removes the authentication barrier. A separate SQL injection (CVE-2026-60137) suddenly becomes reachable. Neither issue tells the full story on its own, but together they can lead to administrative compromise and, ultimately, remote code execution. What makes this case stand out is that the vulnerabilities affect WordPress Core, not a third-party plugin or theme. In our latest blog, we explain: • How the exploit chain works • Which WordPress versions are affected • Why the combined risk is much higher than the individual CVSS scores suggest • What defenders should verify after applying the patches If you're responsible for WordPress environments, this is worth reviewing. ➡️ http://threatmon.io/inside-wp2shell-how-two-wordpress-core-bugs-became-a-critical-rce-chain #WordPress #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence #ApplicationSecurity #RCE #CVE
posts.text_zh: ⚠️ 當兩個「中等」的漏洞相遇時，結果並不總是中等。最近揭露的 wp2shell 鍊是一個很好的例子，說明了為什麼漏洞應該被評估為攻擊路徑而不是孤立的 CVE。 REST API 授權繞過 (CVE-2026-63030) 消除了身分驗證障礙。突然可以存取單獨的 SQL 注入 (CVE-2026-60137)。這兩個問題本身都無法說明全部問題，但它們結合起來可能會導致管理妥協，並最終導致遠端程式碼執行。這個案例之所以引人注目，是因為這些漏洞影響的是 WordPress 核心，而不是第三方外掛或主題。在我們最新的部落格中，我們解釋了： • 漏洞利用鍊如何運作 • 哪些 WordPress 版本受到影響 • 為什麼綜合風險遠高於單一 CVSS 分數建議的風險 • 應用修補程式後防禦者應驗證哪些內容 如果您負責 WordPress 環境，則值得查看。 ➡️ http://threatmon.io/inside-wp2shell-how-two-wordpress-core-bugs-became-a-ritic-rce-chain #WordPress #Cyber​​Security #ThreatIntelligence #ApplicationSecurity #RCE #CVE

posts.text: 🚨 Critical WordPress Pre-Auth Exploit Chain: WP2Shell A newly disclosed exploit chain, WP2Shell, allows attackers to fully compromise vulnerable WordPress sites without authentication. ThreatMon IntelHub has released a free detection tool to help identify exposed instances. 🔎 Check your site: ThreatMon IntelHub - Free Security Tools The vulnerability chain 🔸 CVE-2026-63030 – Route confusion in the REST /batch/v1 endpoint 🔸 CVE-2026-60137 – SQL Injection via WP_Query::author__not_in Potential impact An unauthenticated attacker can: ✅ Verify the SQL injection remotely ✅ Create a new administrator account ✅ Upload a malicious plugin ✅ Execute arbitrary commands on the server ✅ Achieve full site compromise Affected versions: WordPress 6.8.0 – 7.0.1 About the detection tool ✔️ Detection-only (non-intrusive) ✔️ No account required ✔️ Free to use Recommended actions 🔹 Update WordPress to the latest patched release immediately. 🔹 Review recently created administrator accounts. 🔹 Audit installed and active plugins for anything unfamiliar. 🔹 Restrict access to /wp-json/batch/v1 and ?rest_route=/batch/v1 at the edge until systems are patched. ⏱️ It takes less than 10 seconds to check whether your site is exposed. #WordPress #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence #CVE #WP2Shell #SQLInjection #PreAuth #RCE

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 4M São Paulo Student Records A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor known as 'Confia Company' is allegedly selling a database containing personal information of over 4 million students from the São Paulo State Department of Education (SEDUC-SP). The listing, posted on July 16, 2026, claims the data was extracted directly from the API of 'Sala do Futuro,' the official educational platform used by the state's public school system. According to the post, the dataset covers approximately 1,480 cities within São Paulo state and includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) for each student. The alleged exposed fields include: * Student ID and RA (Registration Number) * Full name * CPF (Brazilian national ID) and RG (state ID) * Date of birth and gender * Email addresses * Parents' full names * Complete home addresses (street, number, neighborhood, ZIP code, city, state) * Geolocation coordinates (latitude/longitude) * Class enrollment details The listing provides sample records showing data for students in cities such as São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Araraquara, and São Caetano do Sul, confirming the presence of CPFs, parent names, and precise address details. The actor invites interested buyers to contact them via Telegram or Session for pricing. São Paulo State is the largest education system in Brazil, serving millions of students annually. The exposure of such granular data, including geolocation and national identification numbers, poses significant risks of identity theft, social engineering, and physical safety threats to minors and their families. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by SEDUC-SP or security researchers. #DataBreach #EducationSecurity #Brazil #SaoPaulo #PII #DarkWeb #StudentData

posts.text: ⚠️ Threat Actor Claims 605M Pakistan CNIC Records Leaked on Darkweb A darkweb forum post reveals the alleged exposure of a massive dataset containing 605 million rows of Pakistani citizen data, combining national identity records with historical telecom information. The actor, operating under the handle "PKMKB," claims to have compiled this dataset over more than a decade by merging older leaked telecom directories and provincial agency breaches. According to the listing, the exposed data includes highly sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and tracking details: * **Core National Identity Data:** 13-digit Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) numbers, full legal names, gender, dates of birth, and family tree links including parentage. * **Telecom Trackers:** Active and historically registered mobile numbers mapped to specific IDs, SIM card issuance dates with exact activation timestamps, and network operator data for carriers such as Jazz, Telenor, Zong, and Ufone. * **Locational Data:** Permanent and temporary home and work addresses submitted during CNIC registrations, along with city and district routing information. The post alleges that half of the dataset is available for free via a Telegram bot, while the full archive is offered for sale. Pakistan’s National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) manages the CNIC system for a population of over 240 million people. While the claimed volume of 605 million rows exceeds the country's population, the actor attributes this to overlapping historical records and multi-generational telecom mappings. If authentic, the exposure of comprehensive identity and telecom records could facilitate large-scale identity theft, financial fraud, and targeted harassment across Pakistan. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by NADRA or security researchers. #DataBreach #Pakistan #CNIC #IdentityTheft #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: ⚠️ 威脅行為者聲稱 6.05 億巴基斯坦 CNIC 記錄在暗網上洩露 一篇暗網論壇帖子揭露了包含 6.05 億行巴基斯坦公民數據的海量數據集的洩露，該數據集將國民身份記錄與歷史電信信息相結合。該攻擊者以「PKMKB」為名，聲稱透過合併舊的洩漏的電信目錄和省級機構的違規行為，在十多年來編制了該資料集。根據清單，暴露的資料包括高度敏感的個人識別資訊 (PII) 和追蹤詳細資料：* **核心國民身分資料：** 13 位電腦化國民身分證 (CNIC) 號碼、法定全名、性別、出生日期以及包括出身的家譜連結。 * **電信追蹤器：** 映射到特定 ID 的活躍和歷史註冊手機號碼、具有準確激活時間戳的 SIM 卡發行日期以及 Jazz、Telenor、Zong 和 Ufone 等運營商的網路運營商數據。 * **位置資料：** CNIC 註冊期間提交的永久和臨時家庭和工作地址，以及城市和地區的路線資訊。該貼文聲稱一半的資料集可透過 Telegram 機器人免費取得，而完整的檔案則可供出售。巴基斯坦國家資料庫和註冊局 (NADRA) 管理著超過 2.4 億人口的 CNIC 系統。雖然聲稱的 6.05 億行數據量超過了該國的人口數量，但該行為者將其歸因於重疊的歷史記錄和多代電信映射。如果屬實，全面的身份和電信記錄的暴露可能會助長巴基斯坦各地的大規模身份盜竊、金融詐欺和有針對性的騷擾。截至本報告發佈時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到 NADRA 或安全研究人員的獨立核實。 #DataBreach #巴基斯坦 #CNIC #IdentityTheft #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of Coinbase Customer Data on Darkweb Forum A post on an underground forum alleges the availability of a database containing personal and financial information of Coinbase users. The actor claims the data, described as "2026 Crypto Leads," includes balance information and contact details for individuals worldwide. According to the listing, the dataset contains the following fields: * Name * Email * Address * Postal Code * City * Phone Number * International Phone Number * Confirmation Status * Company * Rent Information * Interest Details * Country * Crypto Platform * Crypto Balance The threat actor asserts that the source of this data is a combination of internal API leaks and compromised merchant processors. The post indicates that the data is available for purchase globally, with the seller requesting direct messages for further details. Coinbase is one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges in the world, serving millions of users across numerous countries. A breach of this scale would represent a significant security incident for the fintech giant, potentially exposing sensitive financial profiles to fraudsters. At the time of reporting, Coinbase has not commented on the alleged leak, and the incident has not been independently verified.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱在暗網論壇上出售 Coinbase 客戶資料 地下論壇上的一篇貼文聲稱存在包含 Coinbase 用戶個人和財務資訊的資料庫。該行為者聲稱，這些被描述為「2026 Crypto Leads」的數據包括世界各地個人的餘額資訊和聯絡資訊。根據清單，該資料集包含以下欄位： * 姓名 * 電子郵件 * 地址 * 郵遞區號 * 城市 * 電話號碼 * 國際電話號碼 * 確認狀態 * 公司 * 租金資訊 * 興趣詳細資料 * 國家 * 加密平台 * 加密餘額 威脅行為者聲稱該資料的來源是內部 API 洩漏和受損的商家處理器的組合。該貼文表明，該數據可在全球範圍內購買，賣家需要直接發送訊息以獲取更多詳細資訊。 Coinbase 是世界上最大的加密貨幣交易所之一，為多個國家的數百萬用戶提供服務。對於這家金融科技巨頭來說，如此規模的違規行為將構成重大安全事件，並可能將敏感的財務資料暴露給詐欺者。截至發稿時，Coinbase 尚未對涉嫌洩密事件發表評論，該事件也尚未獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Leak of SpaceX Starshield Internal Architecture Document A post on an underground forum alleges the exposure of an internal technical document related to SpaceX’s Starshield program, a secure satellite constellation designed for government and defense applications. The listing claims to offer access to a 22-page document titled "Starshield Constellation Technical Baseline and Architecture Description," bearing the document number SPX-STARS HLD-LIN-2026-042 and dated June 12, 2026. The file is marked with watermarks indicating "SPACE PROPRIETARY / STARSHIELD PROGRAM / INTERNAL USE ONLY." According to the post, the document provides a detailed technical baseline and architecture description of the Starshield network. The actor claims the content covers several critical aspects of the system: * Constellation architecture and orbital design * Satellite bus design, subsystems, and physical characteristics * Payload integration and hosted payload capabilities * Secure communications and inter-satellite links * Ground segment and user terminal integration * Launch vehicles, deployment strategy, and on-orbit operations * Operational status, performance metrics, and lessons learned The listing describes the material as valuable for aerospace engineers, defense researchers, and investors, suggesting it offers rare insights into SpaceX’s secure satellite infrastructure. Starshield is a significant component of SpaceX’s broader strategy in the space and defense sectors, providing secure communications and Earth observation capabilities for government clients. If authentic, the exposure of such internal architectural details could provide adversaries with insights into the physical and operational design of secure satellite networks, potentially aiding in the development of countermeasures or targeted attacks against critical space infrastructure. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified, and the authenticity of the document remains unconfirmed.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱 SpaceX Starshield 內部架構文件被洩露 地下論壇上的一篇帖子聲稱，與 SpaceX Starshield 計劃相關的內部技術文件被曝光，該計劃是一個專為政府和國防應用而設計的安全衛星星座。該清單聲稱可以存取一份名為「Starshield Constellation Technical Baseline and Architecture Description」的 22 頁文件，文件編號為 SPX-STARS HLD-LIN-2026-042，日期為 2026 年 6 月 12 日。該文件標有浮水印，指示「太空專有/STARSHIELD 計劃/僅供內部使用」。貼文稱，該文件提供了 Starshield 網路的詳細技術基準和架構描述。該演員聲稱內容涵蓋了該系統的幾個關鍵方面： * 星座架構和軌道設計 * 衛星總線設計、子系統和物理特性 * 有效載荷集成和託管有效載荷能力 * 安全通信和衛星間鏈路 * 地面部分和用戶終端集成 * 運載火箭、部署策略和在航空操作工程師 運行狀態、性能指標和經驗教訓X的安全衛星基礎設施提供了罕見的見解。 Starshield 是 SpaceX 在太空和國防部門更廣泛戰略的重要組成部分，為政府客戶提供安全通訊和地球觀測能力。如果屬實，此類內部架構細節的暴露可以讓對手深入了解安全衛星網路的實體和操作設計，可能有助於制定針對關鍵太空基礎設施的對策或有針對性的攻擊。截至報告時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到獨立核實，該文件的真實性仍未得到證實。

posts.text: 🚨 ShadowByt3$ Claims Breach of Sinar Mas Agribusiness, Exposes HR and Payroll Data A threat actor operating under the alias ShadowByt3$ claims to have breached Sinar Mas Agribusiness and Food (SMAF), a major subsidiary of the Indonesian conglomerate Sinar Mas Group. According to a post on an underground forum, the group alleges it gained access to the company’s workforce URL and is now exposing sensitive internal data after failing to receive a ransom payment. The actor alleges that the leak includes a wide range of sensitive employee data and corporate intellectual property. The post enumerates the following categories of exposed information: * **Government & Tax Identifiers:** Digital copies of Indonesian National ID Cards (KTP), Family Cards (KK), electronic tax cards (NPWP-Elektronik), salary declarations, and academic certificates. * **Corporate Payroll & Financial Logs:** Expense ledger spreadsheets, cash advance records, administrative transaction logs, and medical benefits forms for the Indonesian healthcare system (BPJS Kesehatan) and pension records. * **Talent Tracking & Strategy:** Executive talent cards for specific employees (Fitri Rahmiyani, Anton, and Ilyasa Deva Wirabuana), performance appraisals, and proprietary Balanced Scorecard alignment metrics. * **Internal HR Guides:** Internal toolkits for Performance Improvement Plans, exit checklists for various sectors (Refinery, Upstream, Corporate, Trading), and the 2023 SMAF Learning Catalogue. * **Workday Infrastructure:** Archives of Workday Knowledge bases, platform layout blueprints, corporate letterheads, and IT security procedures for handling locked user accounts. Sinar Mas Agribusiness and Food is one of the world’s largest producers of palm oil, supplying major global brands including Unilever, Nestlé, Procter & Gamble, Mondelēz International, and Johnson & Johnson. The threat actor claims that due to supply chain interdependencies, this breach also impacts these downstream partners, although no evidence of direct compromise at those companies was provided in the post. The data dump is reportedly hosted on MEGA, with mirrors on http://transfer.it and http://anonfilesnew.com, totaling 375.66MB. The actor states that the company was aware of the breach but failed to contact them, leading to the public exposure. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or confirmed by Sinar Mas Group.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 ShadowByt3$ 聲稱入侵金光農業企業，暴露人力資源和薪資數據 一個化名 ShadowByt3$ 的威脅行為者聲稱入侵了印度尼西亞金光集團的主要子公司金光農業食品公司 (SMAF)。根據地下論壇上的一篇帖子，該組織聲稱它獲得了該公司員工 URL 的訪問權限，並且在未能收到贖金後正在暴露敏感的內部數據。該行為者聲稱，洩漏的內容包括廣泛的敏感員工資料和公司智慧財產權。該貼文列舉了以下幾類暴露的資訊：* **政府和稅務識別碼：** 印尼國民身分證（KTP）、家庭卡（KK）、電子稅卡（NPWP-Elektronik）、薪資申報單和學歷證書的數位副本。 * **公司薪資和財務日誌：** 費用分類帳電子表格、現金預支記錄、管理交易日誌以及印尼醫療保健系統 (BPJS Kesehatan) 的醫療福利表和退休金記錄。 * **人才追蹤與策略：** 針對特定員工（Fitri Rahmiyani、Anton 和 Ilyasa Deva Wirabuana）的高階主管人才卡、績效評估和專有的平衡計分卡調整指標。 * **內部人力資源指南：** 績效改進計劃的內部工具包、各個部門（煉油廠、上游、企業、貿易）的退出清單以及 2023 年 SMAF 學習目錄。 * **Workday 基礎架構：** Workday 知識庫檔案、平台佈局藍圖、公司信箋以及用於處理鎖定使用者帳戶的 IT 安全程序。金光農業食品公司是全球最大的棕櫚油生產商之一，為聯合利華、雀巢、寶潔、億滋國際和強生等全球主要品牌供貨。威脅行為者聲稱，由於供應鏈的相互依賴性，這種違規行為也會影響這些下游合作夥伴，儘管貼文中沒有提供這些公司直接受到損害的證據。據報道，資料轉儲託管在 MEGA 上，鏡像位於 http://transfer.it 和 http://anonfilesnew.com 上，總計 375.66MB。該演員表示，該公司知道這項違規行為，但沒有聯繫他們，導致公眾曝光。截至報告時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到安全研究人員的獨立核實或金光集團的確認。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Promotes "DarkMatter" Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) Affiliate Program A threat actor announced the launch of a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) affiliate program named DarkMatter, targeting small, medium, and large enterprises. According to the post, the group states that it does not permit attacks against organizations located in the CIS region or the healthcare sector, while promoting long-term partnerships and operational support for affiliates. According to the advertisement, the threat actor provides affiliates with customized ransomware builds, dedicated Tor-based management panels, real-time callback reporting, encrypted communications, and ongoing operational support. The offering also supports multiple payload formats, including executable files, DLLs, PowerShell scripts, batch files, and memory-only (fileless) payloads, allowing affiliates to tailor deployments to different attack scenarios. The advertised ransomware is claimed to support a wide range of capabilities, including: - Configurable file encryption and deployment options - Active Directory integration and domain-wide propagation - Network spreading through SMB, PsExec, and Group Policy - Credential dumping and privilege impersonation - Defense evasion and anti-analysis techniques - Anti-debugging, anti-VM, and sandbox detection - Backup and shadow copy deletion - ESXi virtualization environment targeting - Tor-based victim portals for ransom negotiations #RaaS #ThreatIntelligence #DarkWeb
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者推廣「DarkMatter」勒索軟體即服務 (RaaS) 附屬計劃 威脅行為者宣布推出名為 DarkMatter 的勒索軟體即服務 (RaaS) 附屬計劃，針對小型、中型和大型企業。該貼文稱，該組織聲明不允許對位於獨聯體地區或醫療保健行業的組織進行攻擊，同時促進對附屬機構的長期合作夥伴關係和營運支援。根據廣告，威脅行為者為附屬機構提供客製化的勒索軟體版本、基於 Tor 的專用管理面板、即時回調報告、加密通訊和持續的營運支援。該產品還支援多種有效負載格式，包括可執行檔、DLL、PowerShell 腳本、批次檔和僅記憶體（無檔案）有效負載，允許分公司根據不同的攻擊場景自訂部署。宣傳的勒索軟體據稱支援多種功能，包括： - 可設定的檔案加密和部署選項 - Active Directory 整合和網域範圍傳播 - 透過 SMB、PsExec 和群組原則進行網路傳播 - 憑證轉儲和特權模擬 - 防禦規避和反分析技術 - 反偵錯、反虛擬機和沙匣偵測 - 備份和磁碟區副本版面複製和反分析技術 - 反偵錯、反虛擬機和沙匣偵測 - 備份和磁碟區複製版面紙 - ESXi 環境複製#ThreatIntelligence #DarkWeb

posts.text: ⚠️ Alleged TotalEnergies Customer Database Leak on Darkweb Forum A post on the Darkforums underground community claims to offer a database containing personal and account details of 20 million TotalEnergies customers for sale. The actor, operating under the handle @MrL33tH4, alleges that the dataset includes full information for residential clients in France. According to the listing, the database is priced at 650 euros. The seller provides a sample of the data structure, which reportedly contains the following fields: * Civilité (Title) * Nom (Last Name) * Prénom (First Name) * Téléphone (Phone Number) * Identifiant du point (Point Identifier) * fournisseur (Supplier) * Catégorie client (Client Category) * adresse (Address) * Code postal (Postal Code) * Commune (City/Municipality) * Formule tarifaire (Tariff Formula) * Calendrier Fournisseur (Supplier Calendar) * Puissance souscrite demandée (Subscribed Power Requested) * country The sample entries shown in the thread display French residential addresses, phone numbers, and specific energy consumption details, such as "Tarif BT <= 36kVA" and subscribed power levels like "6 kVA" or "9 kVA". The actor claims the source website is http://totalenergies.fr. TotalEnergies is a major multinational energy company headquartered in France, serving millions of customers globally. If authentic, the exposure of such detailed customer records including names, addresses, and phone numbers could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns, social engineering attacks, or identity theft against French residents. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by TotalEnergies or security researchers.
posts.text_zh: ⚠️ Darkweb 論壇上涉嫌 TotalEnergies 客戶資料庫洩露 Darkforums 地下社群上的一篇貼文聲稱提供一個包含 2000 萬 TotalEnergies 客戶個人和帳戶詳細資訊的資料庫可供出售。該攻擊者以 @MrL33tH4 為名進行操作，聲稱該資料集包含法國住宅客戶的完整資訊。根據清單，該資料庫售價為650歐元。賣家提供了資料結構樣本，據報導其中包含以下欄位： * Civilité（頭銜） * Nom（姓氏） * Prénom（名字） * Téléphone（電話號碼） * Identifiant du point（點識別碼） * fournisseur（供應商） * Catégorie client（客戶類別） Formula tarifaire（關稅公式）* Calendrier Fournisseur（供應商日曆）* Puissance souscritedemandée（請求的訂閱功率）*國家/地區線程中顯示的示例條目顯示法國住宅地址、電話號碼和特定能源消耗詳細信息，例如“Tarif BT <= 36kVA”和訂閱功率級別，例如“96 kVA”。該演員聲稱來源網站是 http://totalenergies.fr。 TotalEnergies 是一家總部位於法國的大型跨國能源公司，為全球數百萬客戶提供服務。如果真實，暴露此類詳細的客戶記錄（包括姓名、地址和電話號碼）可能會促進針對法國居民的有針對性的網路釣魚活動、社會工程攻擊或身分盜竊。截至本報告發布之時，TotalEnergies 或安全研究人員尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 40,000 Askari Bank Records Leaked on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that a database containing approximately 40,000 records from Askari Bank, one of Pakistan’s largest financial institutions, has been compromised and is available for sale. The actor alleges that the leak includes sensitive customer data such as national identification numbers (CNIC), full names, residential addresses, account numbers, and contact details. According to the listing, the exposed data fields include: * Bank name and branch name * CNIC / National ID * Customer Name * Address * Account number * Contact Number * Account Type (e.g., Saving A/C, Current A/C) The post provides sample entries showing customers from branches in Rawalpindi and Karachi, including specific street addresses and phone numbers. Askari Bank is a major player in Pakistan’s banking sector, with a significant retail and corporate customer base. If authentic, the exposure of CNICs alongside account numbers could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns, identity theft, and social engineering attacks against the bank's customers. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Askari Bank or third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱 40,000 條阿斯卡里銀行記錄在暗網上洩露 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱，包含巴基斯坦最大金融機構之一阿斯卡里銀行約 40,000 條記錄的數據庫已被洩露並可供出售。該行為者聲稱，洩露的內容包括敏感的客戶數據，例如國民身分證號碼 (CNIC)、全名、​​居住地址、帳號和聯絡資訊。根據清單，暴露的資料欄位包括： * 銀行名稱和分行名稱 * CNIC / 國民身分證 * 客戶姓名 * 地址 * 帳號 * 聯絡電話 * 帳戶類型（例如，儲蓄帳戶、目前帳戶） 該貼文提供了顯示來自拉瓦爾品第和卡拉奇分行的客戶的樣本條目，包括具體的街道地址和電話號碼。阿斯卡里銀行是巴基斯坦銀行業的主要參與者，擁有龐大的零售和企業客戶群。如果真實，CNIC 與帳號一起暴露可能會促進針對銀行客戶的有針對性的網路釣魚活動、身分盜竊和社會工程攻擊。截至本報告發布之時，Askari Bank 或第三方安全研究人員尚未對涉嫌違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The #malware targets 8 browsers, 31 #cryptowallet extensions, 7 password managers, and 8 desktop wallet applications. Using a modular architecture, ClickLock Stealer employs a GSocket backdoor installer disguised as iCloud, a credential stealer, Keychain stealer, and crypto-focused harvester that extracts #blockchain addresses across 6 chains. All components exfiltrate data via #Telegram Bot API, while the backdoor provides persistent remote access.
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：#malware 的目標是 8 個瀏覽器、31 個 #cryptowallet 擴充功能、7 個密碼管理器和 8 個桌面錢包應用程式。 ClickLock Stealer 採用模組化架構，採用偽裝成 iCloud 的 GSocket 後門安裝程式、憑證竊取程式、鑰匙圈竊取程式和以加密貨幣為中心的收割機，可跨 6 個鏈提取 #blockchain 位址。所有元件都透過#Telegram Bot API 竊取數據，而後門則提供持久的遠端存取。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: #ClickLockStealer implements a layered approach to credential theft. If a victim enters their password willingly, the attack completes in seconds. If they refuse, the #malware installs LaunchAgents for persistence and activates a kill-loop terminating Finder, Dock, SystemUIServer, and Terminal every 210 milliseconds, leaving only a fake password dialog on screen until #compliance is achieved. The same coercion technique forces approval of a macOS Keychain authorization prompt to extract Chrome's Safe Storage AES key.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#ClickLockStealer 實作了一種分層的憑證竊取方法。如果受害者自願輸入密碼，攻擊將在幾秒鐘內完成。如果他們拒絕，#malware 會安裝 LaunchAgents 以實現持久性，並每 210 毫秒啟動一個終止循環，終止 Finder、Dock、SystemUIServer 和終端，只在螢幕上留下一個假密碼對話框，直到實作 #compliance。同樣的強制技術會強制批准 macOS 鑰匙圈授權提示，以擷取 Chrome 的安全儲存 AES 金鑰。

posts.text: A new #macOS stealer named #ClickLockStealer has been discovered with zero detections on VirusTotal, targeting users across Europe, North America, and MEA. The attack chain requires no exploits or elevated privileges to succeed. #ThreatIntel
