posts.text: 🚨 TeamPCP Claims GitHub Internal Repos and Source Code in Fire Sale A threat actor operating under the alias TeamPCP has posted a listing on an underground forum claiming to possess internal repositories and source code from GitHub. The post, dated July 14, 2026, describes the material as a "fire sale," suggesting an urgent attempt to liquidate the stolen assets. According to the statement, the exposed data includes: * Internal repositories * Source code GitHub is a critical component of the global software development infrastructure, hosting millions of public and private repositories for organizations ranging from small startups to major enterprises. A breach of this magnitude would represent a significant compromise of intellectual property and potentially expose vulnerabilities in widely used software libraries. If authentic, exposure of internal repositories could enable intellectual property theft and infrastructure targeting. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified. #DataBreach #SourceCodeLeak #GitHub #TeamPCP #SoftwareSecurity #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: 🚨 TeamPCP 聲稱正在賤賣 GitHub 內部儲存庫和原始程式碼 一個化名 TeamPCP 的威脅行為者在地下論壇上發布了一份清單，聲稱擁有 GitHub 的內部儲存庫和原始程式碼。該貼文日期為 2026 年 7 月 14 日，將該資料描述為“賤賣”，暗示正在緊急嘗試清算被盜資產。根據聲明，暴露的數據包括： * 內部儲存庫 * 原始碼 GitHub 是全球軟體開發基礎設施的關鍵組成部分，為從小新創公司到大型企業等組織託管數百萬個公共和私人儲存庫。如此嚴重的違規行為將嚴重損害智慧財產權，並可能暴露廣泛使用的軟體庫中的漏洞。如果是真實的，內部儲存庫的暴露可能會導致智慧財產權盜竊和基礎設施攻擊。截至本報告發布之時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到獨立核實。 #DataBreach #SourceCodeLeak #GitHub #TeamPCP #SoftwareSecurity #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Breach of Venezuela's INEA, Exposing 115k Mariners' Data A darkweb forum post by the threat actor '[L4TAMFUCK3R$]' alleges a complete breach of the National Institute of Aquatic Spaces (INEA) in Venezuela. According to the listing, the actor claims to have obtained the personal data of 114,265 marine users and 13,485 maritime companies. The post provides proof-of-concept JSON snippets revealing highly sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and biometric data for individual mariners. The exposed data fields include: * Full names and surnames * Identity card numbers (Cédula de Identidad) * Home addresses and phone numbers * Email addresses * Detailed physical descriptions (height, skin color, hair color, eye color, facial features) * Civil status and nationality INEA is a critical government agency in Venezuela responsible for regulating maritime activities and issuing credentials to seafarers. A breach of this scale could facilitate identity theft, social engineering attacks, and physical stalking of maritime professionals across the country. The actor also claims possession of legal documents and employee data for the affected maritime companies. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by INEA or third-party security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 126 GB http://NTC.GOV.PH Data Dump on Darkweb Forum A darkweb forum post alleges the exposure of a massive data dump from the National Telecommunications Commission of the Philippines (NTC), claiming to contain over 200,000 documents and sensitive personal information. The actor, posting under the handle "KLAMMER," asserts that the breach includes internal memos, passwords, face scans, and personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, emails, contact numbers, and addresses. The alleged data is packaged in a 126 GB archive, split into multiple ZIP files for distribution. According to the post, the leaked data encompasses various file formats including PDF, DOCX, SQL, JSON, IMG, EXE, and TXT. The actor claims the following types of data are included in the dump: * Names, emails, and contact numbers * Personal Identifiable Information (PII) and addresses * PIN codes and pass keys * Passwords * Internal memos and sensitive files * Face scans The forum post frames the data leak as retaliation for what the actor describes as government negligence regarding a school shooting incident in Tacloban. The author alleges that law enforcement ignored warnings about an extremist network linked to the attack, leading to the deaths of three students and injuries to twenty others. The post criticizes the government for blaming video games rather than addressing security failures, stating that the data dump is intended to expose this "rotting incompetence." The National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) is the primary regulatory body for telecommunications in the Philippines, overseeing licensing, spectrum management, and consumer protection. A breach of this magnitude could potentially expose sensitive regulatory records and personal data of industry stakeholders or employees if authentic. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by the NTC or third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱暗網論壇上有 126 GB http://NTC.GOV.PH 資料轉儲 暗網論壇上的一篇貼文聲稱，菲律賓國家電信委員會 (NTC) 的大量資料轉儲被曝光，聲稱包含超過 200,000 份文件和敏感個人資訊。該攻擊者以「KLAMMER」為名發帖，聲稱此次洩露包括內部備忘錄、密碼、臉部掃描以及姓名、電子郵件、聯絡電話和地址等個人識別資訊 (PII)。所指控的數據被打包在一個 126 GB 的存檔中，並分成多個 ZIP 檔案進行分發。根據該帖子，洩漏的資料涵蓋多種文件格式，包括 PDF、DOCX、SQL、JSON、IMG、EXE 和 TXT。該演員聲稱轉儲中包含以下類型的數據： * 姓名、電子郵件和聯絡電話 * 個人識別資訊 (PII) 和地址 * PIN 碼和密鑰 * 密碼 * 內部備忘錄和敏感文件 * 面部掃描 論壇帖子將數據洩露描述為對演員所說的政府對塔克洛班校園槍擊事件的疏忽的報復。作者聲稱，執法部門忽視了與這次襲擊有關的極端主義網絡的警告，導致三名學生死亡，另外二十人受傷。這篇文章批評政府指責電子遊戲而不是解決安全問題，並指出資料轉儲的目的是揭露這種「腐爛的無能」。國家電信委員會 (NTC) 是菲律賓電信的主要監管機構，負責監督許可證、頻譜管理和消費者保護。如果真實的話，如此嚴重的違規行為可能會暴露行業利益相關者或員工的敏感監管記錄和個人資料。截至報告發佈時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到 NTC 或第三方安全研究人員的獨立核實。

posts.text: ⚠️ Threat Actor Claims Full Leak of SED Bogotá Education Data A darkweb forum post claims the full leak of personal data belonging to students and teachers from educational institutions in Bogotá, Colombia. The actor, operating under the handle DozerMxOFC, alleges that the breach affects 286 schools and exposes records for over 461,000 students and nearly 16,000 teachers. According to the listing on an underground forum, the compromised dataset includes extensive personally identifiable information (PII) and sensitive health-related data. The post enumerates the following exposed fields: * **Student Data:** Document numbers (CC/NUIP), full names, dates of birth, gender, home addresses, phone numbers, institutional and personal emails, school and campus details, grade information, and health insurance provider names (EPS, IPS, ARS). * **Health & Disability Info:** Disability type codes, health disability codes, and nearby health entity names. * **Teacher Data:** Document numbers, full names, emails, phone numbers, home addresses, positions, gender, dates of birth, and internal system codes. The alleged leak targets the Secretaría de Educación Distrital (SED) of Bogotá, a critical government body responsible for managing public education in Colombia's capital. The exposure of such granular data, including national ID numbers and home addresses for hundreds of thousands of minors, poses significant risks of identity theft, social engineering, and physical safety threats if the data is authentic. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from the Bogotá education authorities. #DataBreach #EducationSecurity #Colombia #PII #DarkWeb #IdentityTheft #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: ⚠️ 威脅行為者聲稱 SED 波哥大教育資料全部洩露 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱哥倫比亞波哥大教育機構的學生和教師的個人資料全部洩露。該攻擊者以 DozerMxOFC 名義進行操作，聲稱此次違規行為影響了 286 所學校，並暴露了超過 461,000 名學生和近 16,000 名教師的記錄。根據地下論壇上的列表，受損的資料集包括大量的個人識別資訊 (PII) 和敏感的健康相關資料。該貼文列舉了以下公開欄位：* **學生資料：** 文件編號 (CC/NUIP)、全名、​​出生日期、性別、家庭住址、電話號碼、機構和個人電子郵件、學校和校園詳細資料、年級資訊以及健康保險提供者名稱（EPS、IPS、ARS）。 * **健康與殘障資訊：** 殘障類型代碼、健康殘障代碼和附近的健康實體名稱。 * **教師資料：** 文件編號、全名、電子郵件、電話號碼、家庭住址、職位、性別、出生日期和內部系統代碼。涉嫌洩密的目標是波哥大教育局（SED），該機構是負責管理哥倫比亞首都公共教育的重要政府機構。此類精細資料（包括數十萬未成年人的身分證號碼和家庭住址）的暴露，如果資料是真實的，將帶來身分盜竊、社會工程和人身安全威脅的重大風險。截至本報告發布之時，安全研究人員或波哥大教育當局的官方聲明尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。 #DataBreach #EducationSecurity #Colombia #PII #DarkWeb #IdentityTheft #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Alfa-Bank Customer Database Leak Exposes 1M Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims to expose a partial customer database belonging to Alfa-Bank, one of Russia’s largest private banks. The listing, published on July 11, 2026, alleges the release of sensitive personal and financial data for over one million individuals. According to the post, the leaked dataset is formatted as a CSV file containing 1,032,464 rows. The actor claims the data was extracted with a last update date of July 2, 2026. The exposed columns reportedly include: * account_id * email * name (full legal name in Cyrillic) * dob (date of birth) * card_number (full primary account numbers) * primary_phone * additional_contacts (secondary phone numbers or emails) Alfa-Bank is a major financial institution in Russia, known for its digital-first banking services and significant market share. The exposure of full card numbers alongside personal identifiers such as dates of birth and phone numbers could facilitate identity theft, social engineering attacks, and fraudulent transactions if the data is authentic. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Alfa-Bank or third-party security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 23.5 TB Breach of Brazilian Health Tech Firm Mobilemed A ransomware threat actor has allegedly breached Mobilemed, a Brazil-based health technology company specializing in cloud-based Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS). According to a post on an underground forum, the attacker claims to have exfiltrated 23.5 TB of data comprising over 52 million files from the organization's infrastructure. The post alleges that the stolen data includes sensitive patient information and internal credentials. The actor claims the dump contains: * 35 million records of patient Personally Identifiable Information (PII) * 17,176,370 personal files * 67,493 account PII records Mobilemed provides critical imaging infrastructure for radiologists, hospitals, and diagnostic centers in Brazil. The exposure of such a large volume of medical data could have severe implications for patient privacy and regulatory compliance under Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD). The threat actor demands a ransom of $1,500,000, setting a deadline of August 1, 2026. The post warns that if the payment is not made, the group intends to publish the full dataset or sell it on the dark web. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Mobilemed or third-party security researchers. #DataBreach #Ransomware #Mobilemed #HealthcareSecurity #Brazil #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: ⚠️ Threat Actor Claims Sale of 15M Records from Rock N' Cash Casino A threat actor is allegedly offering full access to the game server and a database containing over 15 million records from the mobile casino application Rock N' Cash. According to a listing on an underground forum, the seller claims to possess 7 gigabytes of SQL data extracted from the service. The post alleges that the compromised application has been downloaded more than 10 million times on Google Play and is also available on the Apple App Store. The actor claims to have obtained "full access" to the game server alongside the complete user database. The exposed data reportedly includes: * 15 million lines of SQL data * Full administrative access to the game server Rock N' Cash is a popular social casino app developed by Playtika, one of the world's largest online gaming companies. If authentic, the exposure of such a large volume of user data could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns or identity theft against millions of players. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified.

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged L’Assurance Maladie Breach Exposes 66M French Citizens' Health Data A darkweb forum post claims that a massive data breach has compromised the records of over 66 million French citizens, exposing sensitive health insurance information from L’Assurance Maladie, France’s statutory public health-insurance system. The actor alleges that the data was obtained from the Caisse Nationale de l’Assurance Maladie (CNAM), which coordinates the national system, and its local administrative offices, known as CPAM. According to the listing, the leaked dataset contains highly sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and financial details for nearly the entire French population. The post enumerates the following categories of exposed data: * Identity data including full names, dates of birth, and gender * French social-security numbers (numéro de sécurité sociale) * Contact details such as home addresses, phone numbers, and email addresses * Banking information, specifically IBANs used for reimbursements * Medical-administrative records, including primary care physician details and long-term illness (ALD) diagnoses * Account metadata and audit logs The source material includes sample records showing fields such as numero_secu, iban_remboursement, medecin_traitant (treating physician), and specific medical conditions like "Diabète de type 1 et diabète de type 2" (Type 1 and Type 2 Diabetes). The data also reveals the status of rights (statut_droits) and reimbursement rates (taux_remboursement). L’Assurance Maladie is a critical national infrastructure entity in France, managing healthcare coverage and reimbursements for all residents. A breach of this scale would represent one of the largest compromises of citizen data in European history if verified. The exposure of medical conditions and banking details could facilitate targeted fraud, identity theft, and social engineering attacks against millions of individuals. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from CNAM or French authorities.

posts.text: 🚨Alleged http://Daryn.online Breach Exposes 4.2M Kazakh User Records A darkweb forum post claims the exposure of 4.2 million user records from http://daryn.online, a prominent educational platform in Kazakhstan. The listing, posted on an underground forum, alleges that a comprehensive database containing personal information, credentials, and academic data for students, teachers, and administrators has been compromised. According to the post, the leaked dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and authentication details. The actor lists the following fields as exposed: * Full names (first and last) * Phone numbers and email addresses * Password hashes (bcrypt format) * Individual Identification Numbers (IIN) * Birthdates and gender * User roles (student, teacher, admin) * Academic metrics (grades, ratings, lesson counts) * Last known IP addresses The source material includes sample entries showing hashed passwords, active session tokens, and detailed profiles of educators, including one administrator with the email "admin6@mail.ru" and another with "support@daryn.online". The data also reveals internal identifiers such as user_id, school_id, and region_id, suggesting a structured database dump rather than a scraped surface-level leak. http://Daryn.online is a significant player in Kazakhstan's EdTech sector, providing online tutoring and preparation for national university entrance exams. The exposure of millions of records, including minors' data and teacher credentials, poses significant privacy risks and potential for credential stuffing or phishing attacks against the educational community. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by http://Daryn.online or security researchers.

posts.text: In an era where companies need to become more efficient and diverse they’ve basically picked the least efficient way to do it, with the biggest risks and highest costs - because everybody else is doing it. I know somebody at one of the big 4 who has written something in Claude that prompts Claude each twenty minutes for a question, then feeds Claude’s question back into Claude to use their tokens - because token usage is factored into employee evaluations. What are we even doing.
posts.text_zh: 在一個公司需要變得更有效率和多樣化的時代，他們基本上選擇了效率最低的方式來實現這一目標，同時風險最大，成本最高——因為其他人都在這樣做。我認識四大會計師事務所之一的某人，他在 Claude 中寫了一些東西，每二十分鐘提示 Claude 一個問題，然後將 Claude 的問題反饋給 Claude 以使用他們的代幣 - 因為代幣的使用情況會被納入員工評估中。我們到底在做什麼。

posts.name: GossiTheDog
posts.text: This isn’t, btw, a Kevin Doesn’t Use AI rant. I use GenAI extensively for various testing things. I had access to Mythos before almost everybody. I pay for Copilot Pro+. I pay for Gemini. I AI generate terrible songs. I vibecode security scanners. My personal spend exceeds £500 this month to date. Do I think you should make every employee depend on these third party GenAI tools for their job? No. Its ridiculous. You’re also *locked in* to costs you can’t afford which *will rise*. It’s a cliff.

posts.text: ⚠️ 11 Million US Resumes and PII Allegedly Leaked on Darkweb Forum A darkweb forum post claims the exposure of a massive dataset containing 11 million detailed resumes from US job seekers, totaling 1TB of data. The actor alleges that the collection spans over 20 years and includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) such as email addresses, phone numbers, and full home addresses. While the specific source of the breach is not identified in the listing, the actor offers a sample preview to demonstrate data quality before directing interested parties to contact them via Telegram. According to the post, the dataset includes a metadata file (meta.csv) with the following fields: - sjt_user_id: Unique seeker ID - register_date: Account registration date - firstname: First name - lastname: Last name - email: Primary email address - phone: Primary phone number - address: Street address - city: City - state: State/province code - zip: ZIP/postal code - country: Country code - dockey: Resume document key (MD5) - original_name: Original uploaded resume filename - resume_size: File size in bytes - create_date: Resume creation timestamp - modified_date: Last resume update timestamp - saved_filename: Decoded resume filename inside files/ (PDF/DOCX/DOC) The sample preview provided in the thread lists three records with names, emails, phone numbers, cities, states, ZIP codes, and associated resume filenames in DOCX format. If authentic, this leak could facilitate large-scale identity theft, targeted phishing campaigns, and social engineering attacks against individuals across the United States. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified, nor has the original source of the data been confirmed. #DataBreach #PII #IdentityTheft #DarkWeb #USPrivacy #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Massive FortiGate Credential Leak Affecting Spotify, Samsung, and Oracle A darkweb forum post reveals the alleged sale of a large dataset containing credentials tied to FortiGate SSL-VPN portals and administrative access points. The actor claims the dataset, labeled as "FortiBleed dataset 2026," contains 68,520 total credential records spanning 21,387 distinct domains. According to the listing, the data includes masked login URLs, corporate email addresses (FortiGuardID), and the country of access for each record. The post alleges that credentials for several major global technology and enterprise organizations are included in the leak. The top affected domains by estimated user count listed in the sample include: * http://spotify.com – Music Streaming – 4,223,908 users * http://samsung.com – Consumer Electronics – 2,325,467 users * http://spe.sony.com – Entertainment Media – 1,958,292 users * http://mihoyo.com – Video Games – 723,402 users * http://oracle.com – Enterprise Software – 704,733 users * http://mercadolivre.com – E-commerce Marketplace – 694,280 users * http://service.alibaba.com – E-commerce Marketplace – 611,722 users * http://huawei.com – Telecommunications Equipment – 478,509 users * http://epfindia.gov.in – Government Services – 339,113 users * http://lenovo.com – Computer Hardware – 272,000 users The seller claims that 400 to 500 of the accessed credentials remain valid. The geographic distribution of the records reportedly shows significant activity from India (9,371 records), the USA (6,151 records), Taiwan (3,419 records), Mexico (3,149 records), and Turkey (2,894 records). The file size is listed as 8.68 MB. If authentic, exposure of valid FortiGate VPN credentials could enable unauthorized remote access to internal corporate networks, potentially leading to lateral movement and data exfiltration within these high-value targets. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by the affected organizations or security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Breach of Keccel Billing Database Exposing 3.4M Congolese Numbers A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor has allegedly obtained full access to the billing database of Keccel Technologies S.A.R.L, a fintech and SMS gateway provider based in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo. The actor claims to have compromised the company's entire billing and event infrastructure, exposing data related to 29 corporate clients who route A2P SMS and WhatsApp messages through major Congolese operators. According to the listing, the breach exposes significant volumes of communication metadata and subscriber information: * **3,424,158** unique phone numbers from the DRC (+243) * **35,698,321** total SMS events * **26,428,316** billable SMS messages The post details the distribution of this traffic across mobile network operators, with Airtel accounting for 39.4% of phones (1,348,955) and Vodacom holding 26.0% (890,293). Orange and Africell follow with 24.0% and 8.7% respectively. The actor also lists top sender brands utilizing the gateway, including gambling platforms like Winner Bet and betPawa, financial services such as Visa Pay, and technology firms like Altech and Africa's Talking. Sample data provided in the thread includes CSV exports containing customer IDs, organization names, creation timestamps, and billing identifiers for entities such as KECCEL, NETMOBILE, DIGIT MARKET, and MTARGET FRANCE. Additionally, the post displays logs linking specific phone numbers to sender brands and message counts, potentially revealing user engagement patterns for services ranging from banking alerts to betting notifications. Keccel Technologies operates as a critical infrastructure provider for digital communications in the region, facilitating transactions for banks, utilities, and government bodies. If authentic, the exposure of this billing data could enable targeted phishing campaigns against corporate clients or facilitate fraud by revealing active user bases for high-value services. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified.

posts.name: MonThreat
posts.text: 🚨 11.4M Mexico City Citizen Records Allegedly Leaked on Darkweb Forum A darkweb forum post claims the exposure of a database containing personal information for over 11 million residents of Mexico City. The listing, posted by an actor using the handle 'moonsh1n3', alleges that the dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) such as full names, voter IDs, dates of birth, and complete residential addresses. According to the post, the database contains 11,482,760 records in TXT format. The exposed data fields reportedly include: * Voter ID (Clave Elector) * Full Name * Date of Birth * Gender * Occupation * Full Residential Address (Street, Number, Colony, Postal Code) * INE Registration Date The samples provided in the thread show detailed address information, including street names, internal/external numbers, and specific colonies within Mexico City. The actor claims this data covers individuals residing in the capital region. Mexico City is one of the most populous metropolitan areas in the world, with a population exceeding 9 million in the city proper and over 22 million in the greater metropolitan area. A breach of this scale would represent a significant exposure of citizen data, potentially facilitating identity theft, phishing campaigns, and physical security risks for affected individuals. The source of the leak was not specified in the post, nor was any ransom demand or attribution to a specific threat group mentioned. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Mexican authorities or cybersecurity firms.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 1140 萬墨西哥城公民記錄據稱在暗網論壇上洩露 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱，包含超過 1100 萬墨西哥城居民個人信息的數據庫遭到洩露。該清單由一位使用「moonsh1n3」的演員發布，聲稱該資料集包含敏感的個人識別資訊 (PII)，例如全名、選民 ID、出生日期和完整的居住地址。根據該帖子，該資料庫包含 11,482,760 條 TXT 格式的記錄。據報導，暴露的資料欄位包括： * 選民 ID（獨立選舉人） * 全名 * 出生日期 * 性別 * 職業 * 完整居住地址（街道、號碼、殖民地、郵政編碼） * INE 註冊日期 帖子中提供的樣本顯示了詳細的地址信息，包括街道名稱、內部/外部殖民地號碼以及墨西哥城內的特定外部殖民地。該演員聲稱這些數據涵蓋居住在首都地區的個人。墨西哥城是世界上人口最多的大都會區之一，市區人口超過 900 萬，大都會區人口超過 2,200 萬。這種規模的洩漏將意味著公民資料的嚴重暴露，可能會促進身分盜竊、網路釣魚活動以及受影響個人的人身安全風險。貼文中沒有具體說明洩漏的來源，也沒有提到任何贖金要求或歸因於特定的威脅組織。截至本報告發布之時，墨西哥當局或網路安全公司尚未對涉嫌違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Azazie Database Leak Exposes SSNs and Payment Data A darkweb forum post claims to have obtained a database from the US-based fashion retailer Azazie, allegedly containing sensitive customer information including Social Security Numbers (SSNs) and credit card details. The listing, posted under the title "http://azazie.com Database USA," asserts that the stolen SQL file includes user purchase history, order details, and financial data. According to the post, the exposed dataset contains the following types of information: * User purchase records * Order details * Credit card information * Social Security Numbers (SSNs) Azazie is a prominent online marketplace for custom-made dresses and formal wear, operating primarily in the United States. The company has grown significantly in recent years, serving millions of customers for weddings, proms, and other special events. A breach of this magnitude would be particularly damaging due to the inclusion of SSNs, which are high-value targets for identity theft. The actor behind the leak provided a download link via a file-hosting service and listed a Telegram handle for further contact. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Azazie or third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 據稱 Azazie 資料庫洩露暴露了 SSN 和支付資料 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱已從美國時尚零售商 Azazie 獲得了一個資料庫，據稱其中包含敏感的客戶信息，包括社會安全號碼 (SSN) 和信用卡詳細信息。該清單以「http://azazie.com Database USA」為標題發布，聲稱被盜的 SQL 文件包括用戶購買歷史記錄、訂單詳細資訊和財務數據。根據該帖子，暴露的數據集包含以下類型的信息： * 用戶購買記錄 * 訂單詳細信息 * 信用卡信息 * 社會安全號碼 (SSN) Azazie 是一家著名的定制禮服和正裝在線市場，主要在美國運營。近年來，該公司發展迅速，為數百萬客戶的婚禮、舞會和其他特殊活動提供服務。由於社會安全號 (SSN) 是身分盜用的高價值目標，如此嚴重的違規行為將造成特別嚴重的損害。洩密者透過文件託管服務提供了下載鏈接，並列出了 Telegram 句柄以供進一步聯繫。截至本報告發佈時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到 Azazie 或第三方安全研究人員的獨立核實。

posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Security teams are facing a complex adversary landscape where arrests of a few individuals do not stop the overall threat. The decentralized nature of Scattered Spider and its subclusters makes it a constantly evolving menace, focused on social engineering to bypass traditional MFA. Gain a comprehensive understanding of their tactics, objectives, and how the collective operates. Read the full blog here: https://link.group-ib.com/4ba31rU
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：安全團隊面臨複雜的對手形勢，逮捕少數人並不能阻止整體威脅。 Scattered Spider 及其子群集的去中心化性質使其成為一種不斷發展的威脅，專注於社會工程以繞過傳統的 MFA。全面了解他們的策略、目標以及集體的運作方式。在此閱讀完整部落格：https://link.group-ib.com/4ba31rU

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The primary vector for ScatteredSpider’s initial access is highly targeted social engineering, but it relies on a specific toolset to exploit human trust. Subclusters deploy sophisticated #phishing kits that mimic Okta, Microsoft, and Citrix login pages, sometimes only kept online for a few minutes during a phone call. Our deep dive reveals how these attacks are orchestrated, combining vishing and smishing techniques to direct victims to credential-harvesting sites before delivering a #RAT or other payload.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：ScatteredSpider 初始訪問的主要向量是高度針對性的社會工程，但它依賴於特定的工具集來利用人類信任。子叢集部署複雜的 #phishing 工具包，模仿 Okta、Microsoft 和 Citrix 登入頁面，有時僅在通話期間保持線上幾分鐘。我們深入研究了這些攻擊是如何精心策劃的，結合了語音釣魚和網路釣魚技術，在傳遞 #RAT 或其他有效負載之前將受害者引導至憑證收集網站。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Our analysis shows that Scattered Spider subclusters consistently target employees of major identity providers and marketing platforms like Twilio and Mailchimp as a stepping stone. The end goal is rarely the initial victim; it's to leverage internal tools for phishing campaigns against #cryptocurrency users. Simultaneous operations targeting #Okta login pages and crypto wallets prove the primary objective across these independent subclusters remains financial gain through crypto theft.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：我們的分析表明，分散的蜘蛛子集群始終以主要身份提供商和營銷平台（如 Twilio 和 Mailchimp）的員工作為墊腳石。最終目標很少是最初的受害者；它是利用內部工具針對#cryptocurrency 用戶進行網路釣魚活動。針對 #Okta 登入頁面和加密錢包的同時操作證明，這些獨立子集群的主要目標仍然是透過加密盜竊獲得經濟利益。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Beyond digital #socialengineering, one ScatteredSpider subcluster has been observed resorting to physical theft, specifically stealing employee iPads from mobile carrier retail stores. To bypass device locks, attackers would impersonate internal departments to socially engineer the passcode from store staff. This hybrid physical-digital tactic highlights the lengths these subclusters will go to for SIM swapping operations, targeting telco employees and authorized retailers like Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile. #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：除了數字#socialengineering 之外，還觀察到一個 ScatteredSpider 子集群採取物理盜竊手段，特別是從移動運營商零售店竊取員工的 iPad。為了繞過設備鎖，攻擊者會冒充內部部門，對商店員工的密碼進行社會設計。這種實體-數位混合策略凸顯了這些子叢集將在 SIM 交換作業上花費大量時間，目標是電信員工和 Verizon、AT&T 和 T-Mobile 等授權零售商。 #威脅情報

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: Recent research reveals that #ScatteredSpider is not a singular organized group but a decentralized #cybercrime collective comprised of multiple, independent subclusters. This loose affiliation of operators, connected primarily through shared TTPs and social engineering techniques, poses a unique challenge for attribution. Our latest analysis explains how this structure, akin to a hacking movement, provides inherent resilience against #lawenforcement actions. It's not a single group to track, but a persistent culture of cybercrime that evolves continuously.
posts.text_zh: 最近的研究表明，#ScatteredSpider 並不是一個單一的有組織團體，而是由多個獨立子集群組成的去中心化的#cybercrime 集體。營運商的這種鬆散聯繫（主要透過共享 TTP 和社會工程技術進行連接）對歸因提出了獨特的挑戰。我們的最新分析解釋了這種類似於駭客運動的結構如何提供針對#lawenforcement 行動的固有彈性。它不是一個需要追蹤的單一群體，而是一種持續發展的持續網路犯罪文化。

posts.text: #MilleniumRAT (v4.x) marks a significant evolution in the threat landscape. The #malware has been completely rewritten from .NET to a native C++ application, removing .NET dependencies. This architectural shift enables greater stealth and resilience, making detection more challenging. The #Telegram Bot API remains the core C2 mechanism.

posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: SilabRAT places significant emphasis on #cryptocurrency theft. These additions reflect the growing focus on direct monetization within modern #malware ecosystems.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 非常重視#cryptocurrency 竊盜。除了收集憑證和瀏覽器資料之外，它還可以識別與錢包相關的工件，並使用從受感染系統收集的憑證自動嘗試恢復密碼。這些新增內容反映了現代#惡意軟體生態系統中對直接貨幣化的日益關注。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: One of SilabRAT's most notable capabilities is its use of Hidden Virtual Network Computing (HVNC). By interacting with services directly from the victim's device, attackers can perform account activity, access sensitive platforms, and conduct fraudulent operations while appearing as a legitimate user originating from the trusted device and IP address. #InfoSec
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 最顯著的功能之一是它使用隱藏虛擬網路運算 (HVNC)。透過直接從受害者的裝置與服務交互，攻擊者可以執行帳戶活動、存取敏感平台並進行詐騙操作，同時表現為來自受信任裝置和 IP 位址的合法使用者。 #資訊安全

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #SilabRAT is a newly emerging Malware-as-a-Service (#MaaS) platform developed by the threat actor "o1oo1" and advertised on underground forums since late 2025. Sold for $5,000 per month, the Remote Access Trojan (#RAT) combines credential theft, session hijacking, HVNC access, Chrome App-Bound Encryption bypasses using COM elevation, and cryptocurrency-focused tooling into a single platform built for financially motivated cybercrime.
posts.text_zh: #SilabRAT 是一個新興的惡意軟體即服務 (#MaaS) 平台，由威脅行為者「o1oo1」開發，自 2025 年底以來在地下論壇上做廣告。遠端存取木馬 (#RAT) 每月售價 5,000 美元，將憑證盜竊、會話劫持、HVNC 存取、使用 COM 提升的 Chrome 應用程式綁定加密繞過以及以加密貨幣為中心的工具整合到一個為出於經濟動機的網路犯罪。

posts.text: TeamT5 will be exhibiting at Cyber Defense Symposium Atami 2026, a premier event focused on defense and national security. As Japan continues to advance its Active Cyber Defense initiatives, proactive cybersecurity capabilities have become more critical than ever. At our booth, we will showcase our APAC-focused #ThreatIntelligence and #ThreatHunting solutions, designed to help organizations identify, understand, and respond to emerging cyber threats with greater speed and precision. 📅 June 20 (Sat.) ~ June 21 (Sun.) 📍 Atami Korakuen Hotel (Atami City, Shizuoka, Japan) 👉More details: https://www.5th-battlefield.com/ #5thbf @Battlefield5th

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Hey @elonmusk, since you don't seem to have much a media/comms team anymore, can you address the apparently legitimate claim that someone scraped & is now selling data on hundreds of millions of Twitter accounts? Maybe it didn't happen on your watch, but you owe Twitter a reply.
posts.text_zh: 嘿@elonmusk，既然你似乎不再有太多的媒體/通訊團隊，你能解決一下有人在數億個 Twitter 帳戶上抓取並出售數據的明顯合法的說法嗎？也許這不是在你手錶上發生的，但你欠 Twitter 一個回應。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Just enjoyed several glorious days when I didn't even think about Twitter. Wandered back just now to see what's new, and yep about what I expected.
posts.text_zh: 只是享受了幾天美好的時光，我什至沒有想到推特。剛才又回來看看有什麼新鮮事，是的，關於我所期望的。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: This article could easily be updated to reflect the current reason a lot of people here (particularly journalists) have their accounts locked: It slows the firehose of bot replies from gajillions of accounts that don't follow you. It's probably also come to mean FU to Twitter.
posts.text_zh: 這篇文章可以輕鬆更新，以反映當前許多人（尤其是記者）的帳戶被鎖定的原因：它減慢了來自無數不關注您的帳戶的機器人回复的速度。對 Twitter 來說，它也可能意味著 FU。
